```{r Inference Helpers}
# ---- Dependence-aware inference helpers ----

# Tidy coeftest output
tidy_ct <- function(ct) {
  broom::tidy(ct) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = estimate,
      std.error = std.error,
      statistic = statistic,
      p.value = p.value
    )
}

# Newey-West / HAC tidy table for lm
tidy_hac <- function(mod, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = TRUE) {
  vc <- sandwich::NeweyWest(mod, lag = lag, prewhite = prewhite, adjust = adjust)
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(mod, vcov. = vc)
  tidy_ct(ct)
}

# Compare classical vs HC1 vs HAC for lm models
compare_lm_ses <- function(mod, hac_lag = 3) {
  cl <- broom::tidy(mod) |>
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value) |>
    dplyr::rename(se_classic = std.error, p_classic = p.value)

  hc <- {
    ct <- lmtest::coeftest(mod, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(mod, type = "HC1"))
    tidy_ct(ct)
  } |>
    dplyr::select(term, std.error, p.value) |>
    dplyr::rename(se_hc1 = std.error, p_hc1 = p.value)

  hac <- tidy_hac(mod, lag = hac_lag) |>
    dplyr::select(term, std.error, p.value) |>
    dplyr::rename(se_hac = std.error, p_hac = p.value)

  cl |>
    dplyr::left_join(hc, by = "term") |>
    dplyr::left_join(hac, by = "term")
}

# Residual ACF table for quick autocorrelation diagnostics
acf_tbl <- function(mod, lag.max = 12) {
  ac <- stats::acf(resid(mod), plot = FALSE, lag.max = lag.max)
  tibble::tibble(
    lag = as.numeric(ac$lag)[-1],
    acf = as.numeric(ac$acf)[-1]
  )
}

plot_resid_acf <- function(mod, title = "", lag.max = 12) {
  acf_df <- acf_tbl(mod, lag.max = lag.max)
  ggplot(acf_df, aes(lag, acf)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0(title, " — Residual ACF"), x = "Lag", y = "ACF") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Residual/fitted and QQ plots for lm objects
plot_lm_basic <- function(mod, title = "") {
  d <- tibble::tibble(
    fitted = fitted(mod),
    resid  = resid(mod)
  )

  p1 <- ggplot(d, aes(x = fitted, y = resid)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0(title, " — Residuals vs Fitted"), x = "Fitted", y = "Residual") +
    theme_minimal()

  p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(sample = resid)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.35) +
    stat_qq_line() +
    labs(title = paste0(title, " — QQ plot"), x = "Theoretical", y = "Residual quantiles") +
    theme_minimal()

  p1 / p2
}

# Compare multiple VCOV specs for a fixest model
compare_fixest_vcovs <- function(mod, specs = list("iid" = "iid")) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(specs, function(vs, nm) {
    broom::tidy(mod, vcov = vs) |>
      dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) |>
      dplyr::mutate(vcov = nm, .before = 1)
  })
}
```


```{r Diagnostics Helpers}
# ---- Generic weighted diagnostics helpers ----

wrmse_weighted <- function(truth, pred, w) sqrt(weighted.mean((truth - pred)^2, w = w, na.rm = TRUE))
wmae_weighted  <- function(truth, pred, w) weighted.mean(abs(truth - pred), w = w, na.rm = TRUE)

# Residual diagnostics for lm with optional weights
lm_diag_tbl <- function(mod, data = NULL) {
  if (is.null(data)) data <- mod$model
  tibble::tibble(
    fitted = fitted(mod),
    resid  = resid(mod),
    w      = if (!is.null(mod$weights)) mod$weights else rep(1, nrow(data))
  )
}

# Influence summary for lm
lm_influence_tbl <- function(mod) {
  infl <- influence.measures(mod)
  is_inf <- apply(infl$is.inf, 1, any)
  tibble::tibble(
    row = seq_along(is_inf),
    influential = is_inf
  )
}
```


#### Metagame Dynamics

Phase 2 model roles for Metagame Dynamics:
- Primary inferential models for macro ecosystem/environment outcomes:
     `eco_hhi_wlm`, `eco_neff_wlm`, `draw_wlm`, `upset_wlm`, `moves_wlm`
   with HAC/Newey-West inference.

- Primary inferential models for opening composition over time:
     `mn_models[[tc_bucket]]`  (multinomial)

- Descriptive / sensitivity models:
     `share_feols_models[[tc_bucket]]`
     `gam_models[[tc_bucket]]`

```{r Metagame Prep}
# 1) Clean month + time index
mom_tc2 <- mom_tc |>
  filter(!is.na(opening), !is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month)) |>
  mutate(
    month_date = ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dense_rank(month_date))
  )

mm_tc2 <- mm_tc |>
  filter(!is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month)) |>
  mutate(
    month_date = ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dense_rank(month_date))
  )

# 2) Ordered months and strict forward split
months_ordered <- mom_tc2 |>
  distinct(month, month_date, t) |>
  arrange(month_date)

n_months <- nrow(months_ordered)
cut_idx  <- floor(0.80 * n_months)

train_months <- months_ordered |> slice(1:cut_idx) |> pull(month)
test_months  <- months_ordered |> slice((cut_idx+1):n_months) |> pull(month)

stopifnot(length(intersect(train_months, test_months)) == 0)

mom_train <- mom_tc2 |> filter(month %in% train_months)
mom_test  <- mom_tc2 |> filter(month %in% test_months)

mm_train  <- mm_tc2 |> filter(month %in% train_months)
mm_test   <- mm_tc2 |> filter(month %in% test_months)

# sanity
range(mom_train$month_date); range(mom_test$month_date)

# Weighted RMSE helper (used throughout)
eval_wrmse <- function(actual, pred, w) {
  sqrt(sum(w * (actual - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```
```{r Phase3 Helpers}
show_tc <- "blitz"
plot_tc <- "blitz"
t_name <- "t"

# Compact extractor for key lm terms under HAC
extract_hac_terms <- function(mod, model_name, terms_keep, lag = 3) {
  tidy_hac(mod, lag = lag) |>
    dplyr::filter(term %in% terms_keep) |>
    dplyr::mutate(model = model_name, .before = 1)
}

# Simple sign/stability label
sign_label <- function(x, tol = 0) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x > tol ~ "positive",
    x < -tol ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ "near_zero"
  )
}
```


```{r Metagame Ecosystem Over Time}
# Aggregate opening shares into ecosystem metrics per month x tc_bucket
eco <- mom_tc2 |>
  group_by(month, month_date, t, tc_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    total_games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE),
    # concentration / diversity metrics derived from the opening share distribution
    hhi = sum(share^2, na.rm = TRUE),                                        # Herfindahl-Hirschman
    entropy = -sum(if_else(share > 0, share * log(share), 0), na.rm = TRUE), # Shannon entropy
    n_eff = 1 / sum(share^2, na.rm = TRUE),                                  # effective # of openings
    .groups = "drop"
  )

eco_train <- eco |> filter(month %in% train_months)
eco_test  <- eco |> filter(month %in% test_months)

# Weighted linear trends: ecosystem concentration differs by format and may drift over time
eco_hhi_wlm <- lm(hhi ~ tc_bucket * t, data = eco_train, weights = total_games)
eco_neff_wlm <- lm(n_eff ~ tc_bucket * t, data = eco_train, weights = total_games)

# Out-of-sample sanity checks (month-forward)
eco_hhi_wrmse  <- eval_wrmse(eco_test$hhi,  predict(eco_hhi_wlm,  eco_test), eco_test$total_games)
eco_neff_wrmse <- eval_wrmse(eco_test$n_eff,predict(eco_neff_wlm, eco_test), eco_test$total_games)

tibble(metric = c("HHI (concentration)", "N_eff (effective openings)"),
       wrmse  = c(eco_hhi_wrmse, eco_neff_wrmse))

ggplot(eco, aes(x = month_date, y = hhi, color = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "HHI concentration (higher = more concentrated opening pool)",
    title = "Metagame ecosystem concentration over time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r Outcome Environment Over Time}
# These outcomes describe the 'environment' of games in each month x format.
# (opening popularity ignores these by definition)
draw_wlm <- lm(draw_rate ~ tc_bucket * t, data = mm_train, weights = games)
upset_wlm <- lm(upset_rate ~ tc_bucket * t, data = mm_train, weights = games)
moves_wlm <- lm(avg_moves ~ tc_bucket * t, data = mm_train, weights = games)

draw_wrmse  <- eval_wrmse(mm_test$draw_rate,  predict(draw_wlm,  mm_test), mm_test$games)
upset_wrmse <- eval_wrmse(mm_test$upset_rate, predict(upset_wlm, mm_test), mm_test$games)
moves_wrmse <- eval_wrmse(mm_test$avg_moves,  predict(moves_wlm, mm_test), mm_test$games)

tibble(outcome = c("draw_rate", "upset_rate", "avg_moves"),
       wrmse   = c(draw_wrmse, upset_wrmse, moves_wrmse))

mm_long <- mm_tc2 |>
  select(month_date, tc_bucket, draw_rate, upset_rate) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(draw_rate, upset_rate), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

ggplot(mm_long, aes(x = month_date, y = value, color = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Metagame outcome environment over time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r Metagame Opening-Share Descriptive Models}
top_k <- 12
min_games_cell <- 200

top_openings_by_tc <- mom_train |>
  group_by(tc_bucket, opening) |>
  summarise(total_games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(tc_bucket) |>
  slice_max(order_by = total_games, n = top_k, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

mom_train_top <- mom_train |>
  inner_join(top_openings_by_tc |> select(tc_bucket, opening), by = c("tc_bucket","opening")) |>
  filter(games >= min_games_cell)

mom_test_top <- mom_test |>
  inner_join(top_openings_by_tc |> select(tc_bucket, opening), by = c("tc_bucket","opening")) |>
  filter(games >= min_games_cell)

# Descriptive / sensitivity opening-share models:
# FEOLS gives interpretable opening-by-time trend summaries with clustered VCOV options.
# These are no longer the primary inferential model for composition; the multinomial is primary.-
fit_share_feols_tc <- function(tc) {
  dat <- mom_train_top |>
    filter(tc_bucket == tc) |>
    mutate(
      opening = fct_drop(factor(opening)),
      month = factor(month)
    )

  fixest::feols(
    share ~ opening * t,
    data = dat,
    weights = ~games
  )
}

fit_gam_tc <- function(tc) {
  dat <- mom_train_top |> filter(tc_bucket == tc) |>
    mutate(opening = fct_drop(factor(opening)))
  gam(
    share ~ opening + s(t, by = opening, k = 8),
    data = dat,
    weights = games,
    method = "REML"
  )
}

tc_levels <- sort(unique(mom_train_top$tc_bucket))
share_feols_models <- set_names(tc_levels) |> map(fit_share_feols_tc)
gam_models <- set_names(tc_levels) |> map(fit_gam_tc)

# Evaluate both on held-out months
share_feols_eval <- imap_dfr(share_feols_models, function(mod, tc) {
  train_levels <- mom_train_top |>
    filter(tc_bucket == tc) |>
    mutate(opening = fct_drop(factor(opening))) |>
    pull(opening) |>
    levels()

  te <- mom_test_top |>
    filter(tc_bucket == tc) |>
    mutate(opening = factor(opening, levels = train_levels)) |>
    filter(!is.na(opening))

  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te)
  tibble(tc_bucket = tc, model = "FEOLS_share_descriptive", wrmse = eval_wrmse(te$share, pred, te$games))
})

gam_eval <- imap_dfr(gam_models, function(mod, tc) {
  te <- mom_test_top |> filter(tc_bucket == tc) |>
    mutate(opening = factor(opening, levels = levels(mod$model$opening))) |>
    filter(!is.na(opening))
  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te)
  tibble(tc_bucket = tc, model = "GAM_descriptive", wrmse = eval_wrmse(te$share, pred, te$games))
})

bind_rows(share_feols_eval, gam_eval) |> arrange(tc_bucket, model)

dat_all <- mom_tc2 |>
  inner_join(top_openings_by_tc |> filter(tc_bucket == plot_tc) |> select(tc_bucket, opening),
             by = c("tc_bucket","opening")) |>
  filter(tc_bucket == plot_tc, games >= min_games_cell) |>
  mutate(
    opening = factor(opening, levels = levels(gam_models[[plot_tc]]$model$opening)),
    split = if_else(month %in% train_months, "train", "test")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(opening))

dat_all$pred_gam <- predict(gam_models[[plot_tc]], newdata = dat_all)

ggplot(dat_all, aes(x = month_date, y = share, color = opening, group = opening)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = split), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_gam), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Opening share",
    title = paste0("Supporting: top openings share over time with GAM fit (", plot_tc, ")"),
    alpha = "Split"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
```{r Metagame Multinomial}

# 1) Aggregate counts at opening-month-tc (all openings)
counts_long_all <- mom_tc2 |>
  filter(!is.na(opening), !is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month)) |>
  group_by(tc_bucket, month, month_date, t, opening) |>
  summarise(games = sum(games), .groups = "drop")

# 2) Tag top-k vs Other (top openings chosen from TRAIN only)
top_tbl <- top_openings_by_tc |>
  mutate(is_top = TRUE) |>
  select(tc_bucket, opening, is_top)

counts_long_tagged <- counts_long_all |>
  left_join(top_tbl, by = c("tc_bucket","opening")) |>
  mutate(opening2 = if_else(is_top %in% TRUE, opening, "Other")) |>
  group_by(tc_bucket, month, month_date, t, opening2) |>
  summarise(games = sum(games), .groups = "drop")

# 3) Wide format: one row per (tc_bucket, month), one column per opening2
counts_wide <- counts_long_tagged |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = opening2, values_from = games, values_fill = 0)

mn_train <- counts_wide |> filter(month %in% train_months)
mn_test  <- counts_wide |> filter(month %in% test_months)

id_cols <- c("tc_bucket","month","month_date","t")
open_cols <- setdiff(names(mn_train), id_cols)

# 4) Safe names mapping (old -> new) for dplyr::rename(new = old)
name_map <- tibble(
  opening = open_cols,
  safe    = make.names(open_cols, unique = TRUE)
)

rename_vec <- setNames(name_map$opening, name_map$safe)

mn_train2 <- mn_train |> rename(!!!rename_vec)
mn_test2  <- mn_test  |> rename(!!!rename_vec)

safe_open_cols <- name_map$safe

# Sanity
stopifnot(all(safe_open_cols %in% names(mn_train2)))
stopifnot(all(safe_open_cols %in% names(mn_test2)))

# 5) Fit multinomial per tc_bucket
fit_multinom_tc <- function(tc) {
  tr <- mn_train2 |> filter(tc_bucket == tc)

  # response matrix columns (safe names)
  Y <- tr |> select(any_of(safe_open_cols))
  X <- tr |> select(t)

  dat <- bind_cols(X, Y)

  y_part <- paste0("cbind(", paste(names(Y), collapse = ","), ")")
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(y_part, " ~ t"))

  vglm(fml, family = multinomial(), data = dat)
}

mn_models <- mn_train2 |>
  distinct(tc_bucket) |>
  pull(tc_bucket) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(fit_multinom_tc)

# 6) Evaluate with average per-game log loss
mn_logloss <- function(counts, probs, eps = 1e-12) {
  probs <- pmax(probs, eps)
  -sum(counts * log(probs)) / sum(counts)
}

mn_eval <- imap_dfr(mn_models, function(mod, tc) {
  te <- mn_test2 |> filter(tc_bucket == tc)

  Y <- te |> select(any_of(safe_open_cols)) |> as.matrix()
  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te |> select(t), type = "response")

  # Ensure matrices align by column name (VGAM may drop a baseline column)
  pred <- as.matrix(pred)
  if (!is.null(colnames(pred))) {
    # keep only overlapping columns
    common <- intersect(colnames(pred), colnames(Y))
    Y_use <- Y[, common, drop = FALSE]
    pred_use <- pred[, common, drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    # fallback: assume same ordering
    Y_use <- Y
    pred_use <- pred
  }

  probs <- pred_use / rowSums(pred_use)

  row_totals <- rowSums(Y_use)
  row_loss <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(Y_use)), \(i) mn_logloss(Y_use[i,], probs[i,]))

  tibble(
    tc_bucket = tc,
    n_test_months = nrow(te),
    avg_logloss_per_game = weighted.mean(row_loss, w = row_totals)
  )
})

mn_eval
```



```{r Metagame Multinomial Predicted Shares}
# Predicted composition at early vs late time for the primary multinomial model

tc_show <- show_tc
mod <- mn_models[[tc_show]]

te_tc <- mn_test2 |>
  dplyr::filter(tc_bucket == tc_show)

t_min <- min(te_tc$t, na.rm = TRUE)
t_max <- max(te_tc$t, na.rm = TRUE)

newdat <- tibble::tibble(t = c(t_min, t_max))

pred <- predict(mod, newdata = newdat, type = "response")
pred <- as.data.frame(pred) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("row_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(period = c("early_test", "late_test")) |>
  dplyr::select(-row_id) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "opening", values_to = "pred_share")

pred |>
```

```{r Metagame Writeup Helpers}

# Robust SE helper for lm objects
tidy_robust <- function(mod, type = "HC1") {
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(mod, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(mod, type = type))
  broom::tidy(ct) |>
    rename(estimate = estimate, std.error = std.error, statistic = statistic, p.value = p.value)
}

# Simple formula->string helper (for reporting)
fmt_formula <- function(mod) {
  paste(deparse(formula(mod)), collapse = " ")
}

# Make a "fully written out" linear model equation string (long, but paper-ready)
# NOTE: this writes out an equation for the baseline opening + adjustments.
lm_equation_string <- function(mod, opening_var = "opening", time_var = "t", digits = 4) {
  b <- coef(mod)
  terms <- names(b)

  # Separate intercept, main effects, time, and interactions
  b0 <- b["(Intercept)"]
  b_t <- if (time_var %in% terms) b[time_var] else 0

  # Opening main effects: openingX
  op_main <- b[grepl(paste0("^", opening_var), terms) & !grepl(":", terms)]
  # Interactions: openingX:time
  op_int  <- b[grepl(paste0("^", opening_var), terms) & grepl(paste0(":", time_var, "$"), terms)]

  # Build
  lines <- c()
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("\\hat{y} = %.4f %s %.4f\\,%s", 
                            round(b0, digits),
                            ifelse(b_t >= 0, "+", "-"),
                            abs(round(b_t, digits)),
                            time_var))

  if (length(op_main) > 0) {
    for (nm in names(op_main)) {
      # nm like openingPhilidor Defense
      op <- sub(paste0("^", opening_var), "", nm)
      val <- op_main[nm]
      lines <- c(lines, sprintf("\\; %s\\; %.4f\\,\\mathbb{1}[%s=%s]", 
                                ifelse(val >= 0, "+", "-"),
                                abs(round(val, digits)),
                                opening_var,
                                gsub("'", "\\\\'", op)))
    }
  }

  if (length(op_int) > 0) {
    for (nm in names(op_int)) {
      # nm like openingPhilidor Defense:t
      op <- sub(paste0("^", opening_var), "", sub(paste0(":", time_var, "$"), "", nm))
      val <- op_int[nm]
      lines <- c(lines, sprintf("\\; %s\\; %.4f\\,%s\\cdot\\mathbb{1}[%s=%s]", 
                                ifelse(val >= 0, "+", "-"),
                                abs(round(val, digits)),
                                time_var,
                                opening_var,
                                gsub("'", "\\\\'", op)))
    }
  }

  paste0("$", paste(lines, collapse = " "), "$")
}
```

```{r Metagame Multinomial Matrices}
mn_show <- mn_models[[show_tc]]

B <- VGAM::coefvlm(mn_show, matrix = TRUE)  # coefficients
V <- vcov(mn_show)

# Build SEs from vcov; VGAM stores parameters stacked, but coef(summary()) is easiest for SEs
coef_tab <- coef(summary(mn_show))
se_vec <- coef_tab[, "Std. Error"]
names(se_vec) <- rownames(coef_tab)

# Convert the stacked SEs to a (predictor x category) matrix with same dimnames as B
# The coef(summary()) rownames usually look like "(Intercept):1", "t:1", ...
make_se_matrix <- function(B, se_vec) {
  out <- B * NA_real_
  for (r in rownames(B)) {
    for (c in colnames(B)) {
      nm <- paste0(r, ":", c)
      if (nm %in% names(se_vec)) out[r, c] <- se_vec[nm]
    }
  }
  out
}

SE <- make_se_matrix(B, se_vec)

B
SE
```

```{r Metagame Macro Phase3 Time Shape Check}
fit_macro_gam_time <- function(data, y, w_col) {
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(tc_bucket = factor(tc_bucket))

  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(y, " ~ tc_bucket + s(t, k = 6) + s(t, by = tc_bucket, k = 6)")
  )

  mgcv::gam(
    fml,
    data = data,
    weights = data[[w_col]],
    method = "REML"
  )
}

macro_primary <- list(
  eco_hhi  = list(train = eco_train, y = "hhi",        w = "total_games", lm = eco_hhi_wlm),
  eco_neff = list(train = eco_train, y = "n_eff",      w = "total_games", lm = eco_neff_wlm),
  draw     = list(train = mm_train,  y = "draw_rate",  w = "games",       lm = draw_wlm),
  upset    = list(train = mm_train,  y = "upset_rate", w = "games",       lm = upset_wlm),
  moves    = list(train = mm_train,  y = "avg_moves",  w = "games",       lm = moves_wlm)
)

macro_time_shape_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(macro_primary, function(obj, nm) {
  g <- fit_macro_gam_time(obj$train, obj$y, obj$w)

  # compare fitted values at first and last observed month by tc_bucket
  t_min <- min(obj$train$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_max <- max(obj$train$t, na.rm = TRUE)

  newdat <- tidyr::crossing(
    t = c(t_min, t_max),
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(obj$train$tc_bucket))
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(tc_bucket = factor(tc_bucket, levels = levels(factor(obj$train$tc_bucket))))

  pred_lm <- predict(obj$lm, newdata = newdat)
  pred_gam <- predict(g, newdata = newdat)

  out <- newdat |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model = "linear",
      pred = pred_lm
    ) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      newdat |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          model = "flexible",
          pred = pred_gam
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(period = dplyr::if_else(t == t_min, "early", "late")) |>
    dplyr::select(-t) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = pred) |>
    dplyr::mutate(change = late - early, outcome = nm, .before = 1)

  out
})

macro_time_shape_tbl |>
  dplyr::arrange(outcome, tc_bucket, model)
```

```{r Metagame Multinomial Phase3 TopK Robustness}
phase3_top_k <- c(8, 12, 16)
phase3_min_games <- c(100, 200, 500)

fit_mn_spec <- function(top_k_val, min_games_val, tc_show = "blitz") {
  # top-k openings from TRAIN only
  top_tbl_spec <- mom_train |>
    dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, opening) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total_games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(order_by = total_games, n = top_k_val, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # apply top-k tagging
  counts_long_all_spec <- mom_tc2 |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(opening), !is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, month, month_date, t, opening) |>
    dplyr::summarise(games = sum(games), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      top_tbl_spec |>
        dplyr::mutate(is_top = TRUE) |>
        dplyr::select(tc_bucket, opening, is_top),
      by = c("tc_bucket", "opening")
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(opening2 = dplyr::if_else(is_top %in% TRUE, opening, "Other")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, month, month_date, t, opening2) |>
    dplyr::summarise(games = sum(games), .groups = "drop")

  counts_wide_spec <- counts_long_all_spec |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = opening2, values_from = games, values_fill = 0)

  mn_train_spec <- counts_wide_spec |>
    dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months, tc_bucket == tc_show)

  mn_test_spec <- counts_wide_spec |>
    dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months, tc_bucket == tc_show)

  id_cols <- c("tc_bucket", "month", "month_date", "t")
  open_cols <- setdiff(names(mn_train_spec), id_cols)

  if (length(open_cols) < 3 || nrow(mn_train_spec) == 0 || nrow(mn_test_spec) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_categories_train = NA_integer_,
      avg_logloss_per_game = NA_real_,
      top_mover_1 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_1_change = NA_real_,
      top_mover_2 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_2_change = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  # safe names
  name_map_spec <- tibble::tibble(
    opening = open_cols,
    safe = make.names(open_cols, unique = TRUE)
  )
  rename_vec_spec <- setNames(name_map_spec$opening, name_map_spec$safe)

  mn_train2_spec <- mn_train_spec |> dplyr::rename(!!!rename_vec_spec)
  mn_test2_spec  <- mn_test_spec  |> dplyr::rename(!!!rename_vec_spec)

  safe_open_cols_spec <- name_map_spec$safe

  # drop train categories with zero total count
  train_totals <- mn_train2_spec |>
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(safe_open_cols_spec), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

  keep_cols <- names(train_totals)[as.numeric(train_totals[1, ]) > 0]

  if (length(keep_cols) < 2) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_categories_train = length(keep_cols),
      avg_logloss_per_game = NA_real_,
      top_mover_1 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_1_change = NA_real_,
      top_mover_2 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_2_change = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0("cbind(", paste(keep_cols, collapse = ","), ") ~ t")
  )

  mod <- VGAM::vglm(fml, family = VGAM::multinomial(), data = mn_train2_spec)

  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = mn_test2_spec |> dplyr::select(t), type = "response")
  pred <- as.matrix(pred)

  Y <- mn_test2_spec |> dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(keep_cols)) |> as.matrix()

  common <- intersect(colnames(pred), colnames(Y))
  if (length(common) < 2) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_categories_train = length(keep_cols),
      avg_logloss_per_game = NA_real_,
      top_mover_1 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_1_change = NA_real_,
      top_mover_2 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_2_change = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  Y_use <- Y[, common, drop = FALSE]
  pred_use <- pred[, common, drop = FALSE]
  probs <- pred_use / rowSums(pred_use)

  row_loss <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(Y_use)), \(i) mn_logloss(Y_use[i, ], probs[i, ]))

  # early vs late predicted change
  t_min <- min(mn_test2_spec$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_max <- max(mn_test2_spec$t, na.rm = TRUE)

  pred_2 <- predict(
    mod,
    newdata = tibble::tibble(t = c(t_min, t_max)),
    type = "response"
  ) |>
    as.data.frame()

  share_change <- tibble::tibble(
    opening_safe = colnames(pred_2),
    pred_early = as.numeric(pred_2[1, ]),
    pred_late  = as.numeric(pred_2[2, ]),
    change = pred_late - pred_early
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      name_map_spec |>
        dplyr::rename(opening_safe = safe, opening = opening),
      by = "opening_safe"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(opening = dplyr::coalesce(opening, opening_safe)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(change)))

  tibble::tibble(
    n_categories_train = length(keep_cols),
    avg_logloss_per_game = weighted.mean(row_loss, w = rowSums(Y_use)),
    top_mover_1 = share_change$opening[1],
    top_mover_1_change = share_change$change[1],
    top_mover_2 = share_change$opening[2],
    top_mover_2_change = share_change$change[2]
  )
}
```

```{r Macro WLM Fitted Two-Panel Figure}

show_bands <- TRUE   # flip to FALSE if ribbons feel too busy

# 1) Prediction grid over the observed time range
pred_grid <- eco |>
  distinct(month_date, t) |>
  arrange(month_date) |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    tc_bucket = c("blitz", "rapid", "classical")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tc_bucket = factor(tc_bucket, levels = c("blitz", "rapid", "classical"))
  )

# 2) Helper to get lm fitted values + pointwise 95% CI
predict_lm_df <- function(mod, newdata, outcome_name) {
  pr <- predict(mod, newdata = newdata, se.fit = TRUE)

  newdata |>
    mutate(
      metric = outcome_name,
      fit = as.numeric(pr$fit),
      se_fit = as.numeric(pr$se.fit),
      lwr = fit - 1.96 * se_fit,
      upr = fit + 1.96 * se_fit
    )
}

# 3) Predictions for both retained macro WLMs
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  predict_lm_df(eco_hhi_wlm,  pred_grid, "HHI"),
  predict_lm_df(eco_neff_wlm, pred_grid, "N_eff")
) |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("HHI", "N_eff")),
    tc_bucket = fct_recode(tc_bucket,
      "Blitz" = "blitz",
      "Rapid" = "rapid",
      "Classical" = "classical"
    ),
    metric_label = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("HHI", "N_eff"),
      labels = c("HHI", "N_eff")
    )
  )

# 4) Facet labels as plotmath expressions
facet_labs <- labeller(
  metric_label = label_parsed
)

# 5) Plot
p_macro_fit <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = month_date, y = fit, color = tc_bucket, fill = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)
) +
  {
    if (show_bands) {
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.20, linewidth = 0, color = NA)
    }
  } +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric_label,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = facet_labs
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number()
  ) +
  scale_color_few() +
  scale_fill_few() +
  theme_few() +
    theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Replace default strip text with parsed math labels

  facet_wrap(
```

#### Opening Popularity

 Phase 2 model roles for Opening Popularity:
- Primary inferential model:
     `mn_pooled`  (pooled multinomial opening-choice model)

- Sensitivity / descriptive models:
     `nb_fits`   (per-opening NegBin with exposure)
     `wls_fits`  (per-opening weighted share regressions)

```{r Opening Popularity Prep}
# ---- Settings ----
top_k <- 12
rating_bin_width <- 200   # keep consistent with EDA
min_bin_total <- 2000     # drop sparse rating_bin x month x tc cells

# ---- Base table ----
pom2 <- pom_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(opening), !is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month),
    !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(games)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dplyr::dense_rank(month_date)),
    rating_bin = as.integer(floor(avg_rating / rating_bin_width) * rating_bin_width)
  )

# ---- Month-forward split (80/20) ----
months_ordered <- pom2 |>
  dplyr::distinct(month, month_date, t) |>
  dplyr::arrange(month_date)

cut_idx <- floor(0.80 * nrow(months_ordered))
train_months <- months_ordered |> dplyr::slice(1:cut_idx) |> dplyr::pull(month)
test_months  <- months_ordered |> dplyr::slice((cut_idx + 1):nrow(months_ordered)) |> dplyr::pull(month)

stopifnot(length(intersect(train_months, test_months)) == 0)

pom_train <- pom2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months)
pom_test  <- pom2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months)

# ---- Choose Top-K openings POOLED from TRAIN only (across all TCs) ----
top_openings_pooled <- pom_train |>
  dplyr::group_by(opening) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(total_games, n = top_k, with_ties = FALSE)

top_tbl <- top_openings_pooled |>
  dplyr::mutate(is_top = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(opening, is_top)

# ---- Aggregate to adoption counts at (month, tc_bucket, rating_bin, opening2) ----
counts_long <- pom2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(top_tbl, by = "opening") |>
  dplyr::mutate(opening2 = dplyr::if_else(is_top %in% TRUE, opening, "Other")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin, opening2) |>
  dplyr::summarise(games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Total games per (month, tc_bucket, rating_bin) + reliability filter
bin_totals <- counts_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(bin_total = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(bin_total >= min_bin_total)

counts_long <- counts_long |>
  dplyr::inner_join(bin_totals, by = c("month","month_date","t","tc_bucket","rating_bin"))

# ---- Wide response for multinomial ----
counts_wide <- counts_long |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = opening2, values_from = games, values_fill = 0)

train_wide <- counts_wide |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months)
test_wide  <- counts_wide |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months)

id_cols <- c("month","month_date","t","tc_bucket","rating_bin","bin_total")
resp_cols <- setdiff(names(train_wide), id_cols)

# ---- Force "Other" to be the baseline by making it the LAST response column ----
# (VGAM uses the last response category as the reference group by default)
if ("Other" %in% resp_cols) {
  resp_cols <- c(setdiff(resp_cols, "Other"), "Other")
}
train_wide <- train_wide |> dplyr::select(all_of(id_cols), all_of(resp_cols))
test_wide  <- test_wide  |> dplyr::select(all_of(id_cols), all_of(resp_cols))

# ---- Make response names syntactic for VGAM, and keep a mapping for writeup ----
resp_cols_safe <- make.names(resp_cols, unique = TRUE)

train_mn <- train_wide |> dplyr::rename_with(~ make.names(.x, unique = TRUE), all_of(resp_cols))
test_mn  <- test_wide  |> dplyr::rename_with(~ make.names(.x, unique = TRUE), all_of(resp_cols))

name_map <- tibble::tibble(
  opening      = resp_cols,
  opening_safe = resp_cols_safe
)

# ---- Force integer counts explicitly (removes VGAM ycounts warning) ----
train_mn <- train_mn |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(all_of(resp_cols_safe), ~ as.integer(round(.x))))
test_mn  <- test_mn  |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(all_of(resp_cols_safe), ~ as.integer(round(.x))))

# ---- Helper: per-game multinomial log loss ----
mn_logloss <- function(counts, probs, eps = 1e-12) {
  probs <- pmax(probs, eps)
  -sum(counts * log(probs)) / sum(counts)
}

# ---- Metadata you may want later for paper/results ----
op_meta <- list(
  top_k = top_k,
  rating_bin_width = rating_bin_width,
  min_bin_total = min_bin_total,
  train_months = train_months,
  test_months = test_months,
  openings_top = top_openings_pooled
)

# ---- Sanity checks ----

# 1) Any response categories basically absent in a TC? (can cause instability)
train_mn |>
  dplyr::select(tc_bucket, all_of(resp_cols_safe)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(all_of(resp_cols_safe), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-tc_bucket, names_to = "cat", values_to = "total") |>
  dplyr::group_by(cat) |>
  dplyr::summarise(min_total = min(total), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(min_total) |>
  head(10)

# 2) Is "Other" dominating the simplex? (fine, but good to know)
train_mn |>
  dplyr::transmute(other_share = .data$Other / rowSums(dplyr::across(all_of(resp_cols_safe)))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_other = mean(other_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_other  = as.numeric(stats::quantile(other_share, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

```{r Opening Popularity Phase3 Helper}
mn_time_change_tbl_fullspan <- function(mod, data, rating_ref = NULL) {
  if (is.null(rating_ref)) rating_ref <- median(data$rating_bin, na.rm = TRUE)

  t_early <- min(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_late  <- max(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)

  newdat <- tidyr::crossing(
    rating_bin = rating_ref,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = c(t_early, t_late)
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(period = dplyr::if_else(t == t_early, "early", "late"))

  pred_long <- predict_mn_long(
    mod,
    newdat,
    id_cols = c("rating_bin", "tc_bucket", "t", "period")
  )
  
  pred_long |>
    dplyr::select(-t) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = period,
      values_from = pred_share
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(change = late - early) |>
    dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, dplyr::desc(abs(change)))
}

clean_opening_name <- function(x) make.names(x, unique = TRUE)

op_all_mn <- train_mn |>
```

```{r Opening Popularity Prediction Helpers}
make_op_pred_grid <- function(data, rating_ref = NULL, t_ref = NULL) {
  if (is.null(t_ref)) {
    t_ref <- median(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  rating_grid <- sort(unique(data$rating_bin))
  rating_grid <- rating_grid[
    seq(1, length(rating_grid), by = max(1, floor(length(rating_grid) / 6)))
  ]

  tidyr::crossing(
    rating_bin = rating_grid,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = t_ref
  )
}

predict_mn_long <- function(mod, newdata, id_cols = c("rating_bin", "tc_bucket", "t")) {
  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = newdata[, id_cols, drop = FALSE], type = "response") |>
    as.data.frame()

  out <- dplyr::bind_cols(newdata, pred) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -dplyr::all_of(id_cols),
      names_to = "opening",
      values_to = "pred_share"
    )

  out
}
```

```{r Opening Popularity Primary Multinomial Fit}
# Phase 2 primary inferential model:
# pooled multinomial opening-choice model
# Outcome = opening composition across top openings + Other
y_part <- paste0("cbind(", paste(resp_cols_safe, collapse = ","), ")")

# Start moderately: main effects + optional interaction rating_bin:tc_bucket
fml_mn <- as.formula(paste0(
  y_part, " ~ ",
  "scale(rating_bin) + tc_bucket + t + scale(rating_bin):tc_bucket"
))

mn_pooled <- VGAM::vglm(
  fml_mn,
  family = VGAM::multinomial(),
  data = train_mn
)

summary(mn_pooled)
```

```{r Opening Popularity Multinomial Eval}
common <- intersect(colnames(pred), colnames(Y))
Y_use <- Y[, common, drop = FALSE]
pred_use <- pred[, common, drop = FALSE]

probs <- pred_use / rowSums(pred_use)

row_loss <- map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(Y_use)), \(i) mn_logloss(Y_use[i,], probs[i,]))
avg_logloss <- weighted.mean(row_loss, w = rowSums(Y_use))

tibble::tibble(

  n_test_rows = nrow(te),
  avg_logloss_per_game = avg_logloss
```

```{r Opening Popularity Predicted Share Change Over Time}
  dplyr::bind_cols(as.data.frame(pred)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(rating_bin, tc_bucket, t, period),
    names_to = "opening",
    values_to = "pred_share"
  )

share_change <- pred_long |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = pred_share) |>
  dplyr::mutate(change = late_test - early_test) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, dplyr::desc(abs(change)))

share_change |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```


```{r Opening Popularity Count Models Prep}
top_openings <- top_openings_pooled |> dplyr::pull(opening)
openings_to_fit <- top_openings  # length == top_k
stopifnot(length(openings_to_fit) == top_k)

# Choose ONE opening to "write out" (most played overall)
show_opening <- top_openings_pooled |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_games)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(opening)

# Helpers
wrmse_weighted <- function(truth, pred, w) {
  sqrt(weighted.mean((truth - pred)^2, w = w, na.rm = TRUE))
}

safe_glmnb <- function(df) {
  # Guard: NB needs variation and positive exposure
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)
  if (all(df$games == 0)) return(NULL)
  if (any(df$bin_total <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) return(NULL)

  tryCatch(
    MASS::glm.nb(
      games ~ scale(rating_bin) + tc_bucket + t + scale(rating_bin):tc_bucket + offset(log(bin_total)),
      data = df
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

safe_lm_wls <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)
  if (all(is.na(df$share))) return(NULL)
  if (all(df$bin_total <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) return(NULL)

  tryCatch(
    lm(
      share ~ scale(rating_bin) + tc_bucket + t + scale(rating_bin):tc_bucket,
      data = df,
      weights = bin_total
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}
```

```{r Opening Popularity NegBin Sensitivity}
# Sensitivity model only:
# one-opening-at-a-time count model with exposure
# not the primary inferential family for repertoire composition
counts_train <- counts_long |>
  dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rate = games / bin_total)

counts_test <- counts_long |>
  dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rate = games / bin_total)

nb_fits <- map(openings_to_fit, function(op) {
  tr <- counts_train |> dplyr::filter(opening2 == op)
  mod <- safe_glmnb(tr)
  list(opening = op, model = mod)
})
names(nb_fits) <- openings_to_fit

# Eval NegBin (WRMSE on RATE, weighted by bin_total)
nb_eval <- map_dfr(nb_fits, function(x) {
  op <- x$opening
  mod <- x$model

  te <- counts_test |> dplyr::filter(opening2 == op)

  if (is.null(mod) || nrow(te) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      opening = op,
      model_family = "NegBin",
      n_test = nrow(te),
      wrmse_rate = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  pred_counts <- predict(mod, newdata = te, type = "response")
  pred_rate <- pred_counts / te$bin_total

  tibble::tibble(
    opening = op,
    model_family = "NegBin",
    n_test = nrow(te),
    wrmse_rate = wrmse_weighted(te$rate, pred_rate, te$bin_total)
  )
})
```

```{r Opening Popularity WLS Sensitivity}
# Sensitivity model only:
# one-opening-at-a-time weighted share regression
# used as a descriptive/robustness check against multinomial findings

share_train <- share_tbl |>
  dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months, opening2 != "Other", opening2 %in% openings_to_fit)

share_test <- share_tbl |>
  dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months, opening2 != "Other", opening2 %in% openings_to_fit)

wls_fits <- map(openings_to_fit, function(op) {
  tr <- share_train |> dplyr::filter(opening2 == op)
  mod <- safe_lm_wls(tr)
  list(opening = op, model = mod)
})
names(wls_fits) <- openings_to_fit

# Eval WLS (WRMSE on SHARE, weighted by bin_total)
wls_eval <- map_dfr(wls_fits, function(x) {
  op <- x$opening
  mod <- x$model

  te <- share_test |> dplyr::filter(opening2 == op)

  if (is.null(mod) || nrow(te) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      opening = op,
      model_family = "WLS",
      n_test = nrow(te),
      wrmse_share = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  pred_share <- predict(mod, newdata = te)
  tibble::tibble(
    opening = op,
    model_family = "WLS",
    n_test = nrow(te),
    wrmse_share = wrmse_weighted(te$share, pred_share, te$bin_total)
  )
})
```

```{r Opening Popularity Phase3 Threshold Robustness}
phase3_top_k <- c(8, 12, 16)
phase3_min_bin_total <- c(1000, 2000, 5000)

fit_op_mn_spec <- function(top_k_val, min_bin_total_val) {
  pom_spec <- pom_tc |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(opening), !is.na(tc_bucket), !is.na(month),
      !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(games)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
      t = as.integer(dplyr::dense_rank(month_date)),
      rating_bin = as.integer(floor(avg_rating / rating_bin_width) * rating_bin_width)
    )

  pom_train_spec <- pom_spec |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months)
  pom_test_spec  <- pom_spec |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months)

  top_open_spec <- pom_train_spec |>
    dplyr::group_by(opening) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total_games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::slice_max(total_games, n = top_k_val, with_ties = FALSE)

  counts_long_spec <- pom_spec |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      top_open_spec |> dplyr::mutate(is_top = TRUE) |> dplyr::select(opening, is_top),
      by = "opening"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(opening2 = dplyr::if_else(is_top %in% TRUE, opening, "Other")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin, opening2) |>
    dplyr::summarise(games = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  bin_totals_spec <- counts_long_spec |>
    dplyr::group_by(month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin) |>
    dplyr::summarise(bin_total = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(bin_total >= min_bin_total_val)

  counts_long_spec <- counts_long_spec |>
    dplyr::inner_join(bin_totals_spec, by = c("month", "month_date", "t", "tc_bucket", "rating_bin"))

  counts_wide_spec <- counts_long_spec |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = opening2, values_from = games, values_fill = 0)

  train_spec <- counts_wide_spec |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months)
  test_spec  <- counts_wide_spec |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months)

  id_cols <- c("month", "month_date", "t", "tc_bucket", "rating_bin", "bin_total")
  resp_cols <- setdiff(names(train_spec), id_cols)

  if ("Other" %in% resp_cols) resp_cols <- c(setdiff(resp_cols, "Other"), "Other")

  train_spec <- train_spec |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), dplyr::all_of(resp_cols))
  test_spec  <- test_spec  |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(id_cols), dplyr::all_of(resp_cols))

  resp_cols_safe <- make.names(resp_cols, unique = TRUE)

  train_mn_spec <- train_spec |> dplyr::rename_with(~ make.names(.x, unique = TRUE), dplyr::all_of(resp_cols))
  test_mn_spec  <- test_spec  |> dplyr::rename_with(~ make.names(.x, unique = TRUE), dplyr::all_of(resp_cols))

  if (nrow(train_mn_spec) == 0 || nrow(test_mn_spec) == 0 || length(resp_cols_safe) < 3) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_test_rows = NA_integer_,
      n_categories = NA_integer_,
      avg_logloss_per_game = NA_real_,
      top_mover_1 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_1_change = NA_real_,
      top_mover_2 = NA_character_,
      top_mover_2_change = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fml_spec <- as.formula(paste0(
    "cbind(", paste(resp_cols_safe, collapse = ","), ") ~ scale(rating_bin) + tc_bucket + t + scale(rating_bin):tc_bucket"
  ))

  mod <- VGAM::vglm(fml_spec, family = VGAM::multinomial(), data = train_mn_spec)

  Y <- test_mn_spec |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(resp_cols_safe)) |> as.matrix()
  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = test_mn_spec |> dplyr::select(t, tc_bucket, rating_bin), type = "response") |> as.matrix()

  common <- intersect(colnames(pred), colnames(Y))
  Y_use <- Y[, common, drop = FALSE]
  pred_use <- pred[, common, drop = FALSE]
  probs <- pred_use / rowSums(pred_use)

  row_loss <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(Y_use)), \(i) mn_logloss(Y_use[i, ], probs[i, ]))

  all_spec <- train_mn_spec |>
    dplyr::bind_rows(test_mn_spec)
  
  change_tbl <- mn_time_change_tbl_fullspan(mod, all_spec) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(change)))

  tibble::tibble(
    n_test_rows = nrow(test_mn_spec),
    n_categories = length(common),
    avg_logloss_per_game = weighted.mean(row_loss, w = rowSums(Y_use)),
    top_mover_1 = change_tbl$opening[1],
    top_mover_1_change = change_tbl$change[1],
    top_mover_2 = change_tbl$opening[2],
    top_mover_2_change = change_tbl$change[2]
  )
}

op_phase3_thresh <- tidyr::crossing(
  top_k = phase3_top_k,
  min_bin_total = phase3_min_bin_total
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    out = purrr::map2(top_k, min_bin_total, ~ fit_op_mn_spec(.x, .y))
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest(out)

op_phase3_thresh
```

```{r Opening Popularity Phase3 Agreement Summary}
# NegBin sign for t by opening
nb_sign_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(nb_fits, function(x) {
  mod <- x$model
  op <- clean_opening_name(x$opening)
  if (is.null(mod)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(opening = op, nb_t = NA_real_, nb_sign = NA_character_))
  }
  td <- broom::tidy(mod)
  tt <- td |> dplyr::filter(term == "t")
  tibble::tibble(
    opening = op,
    nb_t = if (nrow(tt)) tt$estimate[[1]] else NA_real_,
    nb_sign = sign_label(if (nrow(tt)) tt$estimate[[1]] else NA_real_)
  )
})

# WLS sign for t by opening
wls_sign_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(wls_fits, function(x) {
  mod <- x$model
  op <- clean_opening_name(x$opening)
  if (is.null(mod)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(opening = op, wls_t = NA_real_, wls_sign = NA_character_))
  }
  td <- broom::tidy(mod)
  tt <- td |> dplyr::filter(term == "t")
  tibble::tibble(
    opening = op,
    wls_t = if (nrow(tt)) tt$estimate[[1]] else NA_real_,
    wls_sign = sign_label(if (nrow(tt)) tt$estimate[[1]] else NA_real_)
  )
})

mn_change_primary |>
  dplyr::left_join(nb_sign_tbl, by = "opening") |>
  dplyr::left_join(wls_sign_tbl, by = "opening") |>
  dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, dplyr::desc(abs(mn_change))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 12) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

#### Time-Use

 Phase 2 model roles for Time-Use:

 Primary inferential models for mean time-use:
- `m_macro_add` / `m_macro_int`      (macro month-level, HAC inference)
- `m_player_add_fe` / m`_player_int_fe`  (player-month, clustered inference)

Primary inferential model for low-time frequency:
- `m_frac`   (quasibinomial fractional model)
- `m_binom`  (binomial approximation sensitivity / companion)

Sensitivity / descriptive models:
- `m_rlm`
- `m_q50`, `m_q90`
- phase allocation models

```{r Time Use Prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# ---- Base tables ----
ptm2 <- ptm_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(tc_bucket),
                !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(move_rows)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dplyr::dense_rank(month_date))
  )

mvm2 <- mvm_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(month), !is.na(tc_bucket)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dplyr::dense_rank(month_date))
  )

# ---- Reliability thresholds (tune as you like) ----
min_moves_player <- 100    # player-month-tc must have at least this many moves to be included
ptm2 <- ptm2 |> dplyr::filter(move_rows >= min_moves_player)

# ---- Use the SAME forward split pattern as earlier ----
months_ordered_tu <- ptm2 |>
  dplyr::distinct(month, month_date, t) |>
  dplyr::arrange(month_date)

cut_idx_tu <- floor(0.80 * nrow(months_ordered_tu))
train_months_tu <- months_ordered_tu |> dplyr::slice(1:cut_idx_tu) |> dplyr::pull(month)
test_months_tu  <- months_ordered_tu |> dplyr::slice((cut_idx_tu+1):nrow(months_ordered_tu)) |> dplyr::pull(month)

ptm_train <- ptm2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months_tu)
ptm_test  <- ptm2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months_tu)

mvm_train <- mvm2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months_tu)
mvm_test  <- mvm2 |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months_tu)

stopifnot(length(intersect(train_months_tu, test_months_tu)) == 0)

# ---- Helpers ----
wrmse_weighted <- function(truth, pred, w) sqrt(weighted.mean((truth - pred)^2, w = w, na.rm = TRUE))
wmae_weighted  <- function(truth, pred, w) weighted.mean(abs(truth - pred), w = w, na.rm = TRUE)

# NOTE:
# For player_time_month_tc, move_rows is a natural weight.
# For moves_month_tc, move_rows is already a column in the derived table (called move_rows in the build script).
```

```{r Time Use Phase3 Helpers}
sign_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x > 0 ~ "positive",
    x < 0 ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ "zero"
  )
}

make_mean_time_profile <- function(
  mod,
  data,
  rating_var = "avg_rating",
  outcome_name = "avg_time_spent",
  predict_type = NULL,
  rating_values = NULL
) {
  if (is.null(rating_values)) {
    rating_grid <- sort(unique(data[[rating_var]]))
    rating_grid <- rating_grid[
      seq(1, length(rating_grid), by = max(1, floor(length(rating_grid) / 6)))
    ]
  } else {
    rating_grid <- rating_values
  }

  newdat <- tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_grid,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = median(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  pred <- if (is.null(predict_type)) {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat)
  } else {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat, type = predict_type)
  }

  newdat |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pred_value = as.numeric(pred),
      outcome = outcome_name
    )
}

make_mean_time_change <- function(
  mod,
  data,
  rating_ref = NULL,
  rating_var = "avg_rating",
  outcome_name = "avg_time_spent",
  predict_type = NULL,
  rating_values = NULL
) {
  t_early <- min(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_late  <- max(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (is.null(rating_values)) {
    rating_grid <- if (is.null(rating_ref)) {
      median(data[[rating_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      rating_ref
    }
  } else {
    rating_grid <- rating_values
  }

  newdat_early <- tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_grid,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = t_early
  )

  newdat_late <- tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_grid,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = t_late
  )

  pred_early <- if (is.null(predict_type)) {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat_early)
  } else {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat_early, type = predict_type)
  }

  pred_late <- if (is.null(predict_type)) {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat_late)
  } else {
    predict(mod, newdata = newdat_late, type = predict_type)
  }

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    newdat_early |>
      dplyr::rename(t_early_value = t),
    newdat_late |>
      dplyr::rename(t_late_value = t) |>
      dplyr::select(t_late_value),
    tibble::tibble(
      pred_early = as.numeric(pred_early),
      pred_late  = as.numeric(pred_late),
      change     = as.numeric(pred_late) - as.numeric(pred_early),
      outcome    = outcome_name
    )
  )
}
```


```{r Time Use Primary Macro Mean Models}
# Phase 2 primary inferential models for macro average time-use

# 1) Build a macro "environment" table by joining moves_month_tc to meta_month_tc
#    (Both are month x tc_bucket)
mvm_env <- mvm2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    mm_tc2 |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        month, tc_bucket, month_date, t,
        avg_rating_env = (avg_white_rating + avg_black_rating)/2,
        avg_abs_rating_diff = avg_abs_rating_diff,
        draw_rate = draw_rate
      ),
    by = c("month","tc_bucket","month_date","t")
  )

mvm_env_train <- mvm_env |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months_tu)
mvm_env_test  <- mvm_env |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months_tu)

# 2) Macro models: interpret tc_bucket as control/stratifier, not "the point"
# Additive: common rating effect + tc_bucket shift + time trend
m_macro_add <- lm(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating_env) + tc_bucket + t,
  data = mvm_env_train,
  weights = move_rows
)

# Interaction: allow rating effect to differ by tc_bucket (optional but often reasonable)
m_macro_int <- lm(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating_env) * tc_bucket + t,
  data = mvm_env_train,
  weights = move_rows
)

pred_add <- predict(m_macro_add, newdata = mvm_env_test)
pred_int <- predict(m_macro_int, newdata = mvm_env_test)

tibble::tibble(
  model = c("macro_additive", "macro_interaction"),
  wrmse = c(
    wrmse_weighted(mvm_env_test$avg_time_spent, pred_add, mvm_env_test$move_rows),
    wrmse_weighted(mvm_env_test$avg_time_spent, pred_int, mvm_env_test$move_rows)
  )
)

summary(m_macro_int)

# 3) Repeat across other macro outcomes
macro_targets <- c("median_time_spent", "p90_time_spent", "avg_clock_after", "low_time_rate")

macro_eval <- map_dfr(macro_targets, function(y) {
  f_add <- as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ scale(avg_rating_env) + tc_bucket + t"))
  f_int <- as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ scale(avg_rating_env) * tc_bucket + t"))

  m_add <- lm(f_add, data = mvm_env_train, weights = move_rows)
  m_int <- lm(f_int, data = mvm_env_train, weights = move_rows)

  p_add <- predict(m_add, newdata = mvm_env_test)
  p_int <- predict(m_int, newdata = mvm_env_test)

  tibble::tibble(
    outcome = y,
    model = c("additive", "interaction"),
    wrmse = c(
      wrmse_weighted(mvm_env_test[[y]], p_add, mvm_env_test$move_rows),
      wrmse_weighted(mvm_env_test[[y]], p_int, mvm_env_test$move_rows)
    )
  )
})

macro_eval |> dplyr::arrange(outcome, model)
```

```{r Time Use Primary Player Mean Models}
# Phase 2 primary inferential models for player-level average time-use

# Weight player rows by move_rows (more observed moves = more stable averages)
ptm_train2 <- ptm_train |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(avg_time_spent))
ptm_test2  <- ptm_test  |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(avg_time_spent))

# Phase 1 change: move to fixest::feols so clustered inference is easy
m_player_add_fe <- fixest::feols(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating) + tc_bucket + t,
  data = ptm_train2,
  weights = ~move_rows
)

m_player_int_fe <- fixest::feols(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  data = ptm_train2,
  weights = ~move_rows
)

p_add <- predict(m_player_add_fe, newdata = ptm_test2)
p_int <- predict(m_player_int_fe, newdata = ptm_test2)

tibble::tibble(
  model = c("player_add_fe", "player_int_fe"),
  wrmse = c(
    wrmse_weighted(ptm_test2$avg_time_spent, p_add, ptm_test2$move_rows),
    wrmse_weighted(ptm_test2$avg_time_spent, p_int, ptm_test2$move_rows)
  )
)

summary(m_player_int_fe)
```

```{r Time Use Robust Sensitivity}
# Sensitivity model for outlier robustness; not a primary inferential model
# Robust regression does NOT use weights the same way as lm; keep it simple.
# If you want weights, you can subsample by move_rows or fit per tc_bucket.
# This is still useful as a sensitivity check.

ptm_train_r <- ptm_train2 |>
  dplyr::select(avg_time_spent, avg_rating, tc_bucket, t) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

m_rlm <- MASS::rlm(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  data = ptm_train_r
)

summary(m_rlm)
```
```{r Time Use Quantile Sensitivity}
# Sensitivity models for distributional heterogeneity; not primary unless the estimand is explicitly a quantile
# Median regression (tau=0.5) and "upper tail" regression (tau=0.9)
ptm_train_q <- ptm_train2 |>
  dplyr::select(avg_time_spent, avg_rating, tc_bucket, t) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

m_q50 <- quantreg::rq(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  tau = 0.5,
  data = ptm_train_q
)

m_q90 <- quantreg::rq(
  avg_time_spent ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  tau = 0.9,
  data = ptm_train_q
)

summary(m_q50)
summary(m_q90)

# Out-of-sample quantile metric:
pinball_loss <- function(y, qhat, tau) mean((tau - (y < qhat)) * (y - qhat))

ptm_test_q <- ptm_test2 |>
  dplyr::select(avg_time_spent, avg_rating, tc_bucket, t, move_rows) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

p50 <- predict(m_q50, newdata = ptm_test_q)
p90 <- predict(m_q90, newdata = ptm_test_q)

tibble::tibble(
  model = c("rq_tau_0.5", "rq_tau_0.9"),
  loss = c(
    pinball_loss(ptm_test_q$avg_time_spent, p50, 0.5),
    pinball_loss(ptm_test_q$avg_time_spent, p90, 0.9)
  )
)
```

```{r Time Use Primary Low-Time Model}
# Phase 2 primary inferential model for low-time frequency

ptm_train_ltr <- ptm_train |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(low_time_rate), !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(tc_bucket)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # keep inside (0,1) to avoid boundary issues if you later switch to betareg
    ltr_adj = pmin(pmax(low_time_rate, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  )

ptm_test_ltr <- ptm_test |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(low_time_rate), !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(tc_bucket)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ltr_adj = pmin(pmax(low_time_rate, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  )

m_frac <- glm(
  ltr_adj ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  family = quasibinomial(),
  data = ptm_train_ltr,
  weights = move_rows
)

summary(m_frac)

# Evaluate (Brier-like MSE on proportions), weighted by move_rows
p_frac <- predict(m_frac, newdata = ptm_test_ltr, type = "response")
wrmse_weighted(ptm_test_ltr$low_time_rate, p_frac, ptm_test_ltr$move_rows)
```

```{r Time Use Low-Time Binomial Sensitivity}
# Sensitivity / companion model for low-time frequency

# Approximate successes as round(low_time_rate * move_rows)
# This is a modeling convenience (not exact) but often close if move_rows is large.

ptm_train_bin <- ptm_train |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(low_time_rate), !is.na(move_rows)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    low_time_moves = as.integer(round(low_time_rate * move_rows)),
    low_time_moves = pmin(pmax(low_time_moves, 0L), as.integer(move_rows))
  )

ptm_test_bin <- ptm_test |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(low_time_rate), !is.na(move_rows)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    low_time_moves = as.integer(round(low_time_rate * move_rows)),
    low_time_moves = pmin(pmax(low_time_moves, 0L), as.integer(move_rows))
  )

m_binom <- glm(
  cbind(low_time_moves, move_rows - low_time_moves) ~ scale(avg_rating) * tc_bucket + t,
  family = binomial(),
  data = ptm_train_bin
)

summary(m_binom)

p_bin <- predict(m_binom, newdata = ptm_test_bin, type = "response")
wrmse_weighted(ptm_test_bin$low_time_rate, p_bin, ptm_test_bin$move_rows)
```

```{r Time Use Phase Allocation}
# Secondary mean-model extensions:
# phase-specific average time use (opening, middlegame, endgame)
phase_vars <- c("avg_time_opening", "avg_time_middlegame", "avg_time_endgame")

phase_eval <- map_dfr(phase_vars, function(y) {
  tr <- ptm_train |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[y]]))
  te <- ptm_test  |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[y]]))

  if (nrow(tr) < 200 || nrow(te) < 50) {
    return(tibble::tibble(phase = y, model = NA_character_, wrmse = NA_real_))
  }

  m_add <- lm(
    reformulate(c("scale(avg_rating)", "tc_bucket", "t"), response = y),
    data = tr,
    weights = move_rows
  )
  m_int <- lm(
    reformulate(c("scale(avg_rating)*tc_bucket", "t"), response = y),
    data = tr,
    weights = move_rows
  )

  p_add <- predict(m_add, newdata = te)
  p_int <- predict(m_int, newdata = te)

  tibble::tibble(
    phase = y,
    model = c("additive", "interaction"),
    wrmse = c(
      wrmse_weighted(te[[y]], p_add, te$move_rows),
      wrmse_weighted(te[[y]], p_int, te$move_rows)
    )
  )
})

phase_eval
```

```{r Time Use Primary Mean Model Diagnostics}

plot_lm_basic(m_macro_int, "Macro time-use (interaction)")
```

```{r Time Use Phase3 Uncertainty Tables}
clean_ratings <- c(800, 1600, 2400)
z_crit <- qnorm(0.975)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
safe_model_matrix <- function(mod, newdata) {
  tt <- stats::delete.response(stats::terms(mod))
  stats::model.matrix(tt, data = newdata)
}

pred_ci_from_vcov <- function(mod, newdata, vcov_mat,
                              type = c("identity", "response"),
                              level = 0.95) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  alpha <- 1 - level
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

  X <- safe_model_matrix(mod, newdata)
  b <- stats::coef(mod)

  # align in case vcov/model.matrix names differ in ordering
  keep <- intersect(colnames(X), names(b))
  X <- X[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  b <- b[keep]
  V <- vcov_mat[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]

  eta <- as.numeric(X %*% b)
  se_eta <- sqrt(pmax(0, diag(X %*% V %*% t(X))))

  if (type == "identity") {
    fit <- eta
    lo  <- eta - z * se_eta
    hi  <- eta + z * se_eta
  } else {
    fam <- stats::family(mod)
    fit <- fam$linkinv(eta)
    lo  <- fam$linkinv(eta - z * se_eta)
    hi  <- fam$linkinv(eta + z * se_eta)
  }

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    newdata,
    tibble::tibble(
      estimate = fit,
      std.error = se_eta,
      conf.low = lo,
      conf.high = hi
    )
  )
}

change_ci_from_vcov <- function(mod, newdata_early, newdata_late, vcov_mat,
                                type = c("identity", "response"),
                                level = 0.95) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  alpha <- 1 - level
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

  X0 <- safe_model_matrix(mod, newdata_early)
  X1 <- safe_model_matrix(mod, newdata_late)
  b  <- stats::coef(mod)

  keep <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(X0), colnames(X1), names(b)))
  X0 <- X0[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  X1 <- X1[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  b  <- b[keep]
  V  <- vcov_mat[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]

  eta0 <- as.numeric(X0 %*% b)
  eta1 <- as.numeric(X1 %*% b)
  Xd   <- X1 - X0
  se_d <- sqrt(pmax(0, diag(Xd %*% V %*% t(Xd))))

  if (type == "identity") {
    change <- eta1 - eta0
    lo <- change - z * se_d
    hi <- change + z * se_d
    est0 <- eta0
    est1 <- eta1
  } else {
    fam <- stats::family(mod)
    est0 <- fam$linkinv(eta0)
    est1 <- fam$linkinv(eta1)

    # CI is for link-scale contrast, then mapped as a probability-difference approximation
    # via endpoint transformation.
    lo <- fam$linkinv(eta1 - z * se_d) - fam$linkinv(eta0)
    hi <- fam$linkinv(eta1 + z * se_d) - fam$linkinv(eta0)
    change <- est1 - est0
  }

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    newdata_early |>
      dplyr::rename(t_early_value = t),
    newdata_late |>
      dplyr::rename(t_late_value = t) |>
      dplyr::select(t_late_value),
    tibble::tibble(
      estimate_early = est0,
      estimate_late = est1,
      change = change,
      std.error = se_d,
      conf.low = lo,
      conf.high = hi
    )
  )
}

make_profile_grid <- function(data, rating_values, rating_var = "avg_rating") {
  tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_values,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = median(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

make_change_grid <- function(data, rating_values, rating_var = "avg_rating") {
  t_early <- min(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_late  <- max(data$t, na.rm = TRUE)

  grid_early <- tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_values,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = t_early
  )

  grid_late <- tidyr::crossing(
    !!rlang::sym(rating_var) := rating_values,
    tc_bucket = sort(unique(data$tc_bucket)),
    t = t_late
  )

  list(early = grid_early, late = grid_late)
}
```

```{r Time Use Two-Panel Profile Figure}
pred_mean <- newdat_mean |>
  mutate(
    pred_value = as.numeric(predict(m_player_int_fe, newdata = newdat_mean)),
    panel = "Panel A: Predicted Average Time Spent by Rating and Time Control"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Panel B: retained fractional low-time model
# ----------------------------
newdat_low <- tidyr::crossing(
  avg_rating = rating_vals,
  tc_bucket = sort(unique(ptm_test_ltr$tc_bucket)),
  t = t_ref_low
)

pred_low <- newdat_low |>
  mutate(
    pred_value = as.numeric(predict(m_frac, newdata = newdat_low, type = "response")),
    panel = "Panel B: Predicted Low-Time Frequency by Rating and Time Control"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Combine for faceted plot
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(pred_mean, pred_low) |>
  mutate(
    tc_bucket = factor(
      tc_bucket,
      levels = c("blitz", "rapid", "classical"),
      labels = c("Blitz", "Rapid", "Classical")
    ),
    panel = factor(
      panel,
      levels = c(
        "Panel A: Predicted Average Time Spent by Rating and Time Control",
        "Panel B: Predicted Low-Time Frequency by Rating and Time Control"
      )
    )
  )

p_time_panels <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = avg_rating, y = pred_value, color = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = rating_vals,
    limits = c(min(rating_vals), max(rating_vals))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) x
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Rating",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_few() +
  scale_color_few() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_time_panels

saveRDS(p_time_panels, "../files_for_submission/Paper_files/figure-rds/p_time_panels.rds")
```


#### Player-Progression Models

<!--
Design Choices:

Observational unit: player–month (from pm).
Target: Δrating_{t+1} = avg_rating_{t+1} − avg_rating_t (and optionally 3-month).
Feature timing: all predictors from month t only; target uses month t+1 (or t+3).
Split: forward-in-time by month; no future months in training.
Reliability filters: use games and (if joined) move_rows to reduce volatility.
-->

 Phase 2 model roles for Player Progression:

 Primary inferential models:
- `fe_1m$model`
- `fe_3m$model`
- `fe_abs$model`

Predictive-only benchmark models:
- `ridge_1m`, `ridge_3m`, `ridge_abs`
- `rf_1m`, `rf_3m`, `rf_abs`

Interpretation of FE models:
within-player association between month-t covariates and future rating change

```{r Progression Prep}
# ---- Settings ----
min_games_pm   <- 10   # reliability filter for player-month
min_moves_ptm  <- 40   # if joining time-use, filter for stability
horizons       <- c(1, 3)  # months-ahead targets

# ---- Base player-month table ----
pm2 <- pm |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(games)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(player, month_date) |>
  dplyr::filter(games >= min_games_pm)

# ---- Build future rating targets ----
# d_rating_1m = next month's avg_rating - current
# d_rating_3m = 3 months ahead - current
pm_targets <- pm2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(player) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    next_rating_1m = dplyr::lead(avg_rating, 1),
    next_rating_3m = dplyr::lead(avg_rating, 3),
    d_rating_1m = next_rating_1m - avg_rating,
    d_rating_3m = next_rating_3m - avg_rating,
    abs_d_rating_1m = abs(d_rating_1m)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ---- Month-forward split (use the same month split idea as other sections) ----
months_ordered_pm <- pm_targets |>
  dplyr::distinct(month, month_date) |>
  dplyr::arrange(month_date)

cut_idx <- floor(0.80 * nrow(months_ordered_pm))
train_months_pm <- months_ordered_pm |> dplyr::slice(1:cut_idx) |> dplyr::pull(month)
test_months_pm  <- months_ordered_pm |> dplyr::slice((cut_idx+1):nrow(months_ordered_pm)) |> dplyr::pull(month)

stopifnot(length(intersect(train_months_pm, test_months_pm)) == 0)

pm_train0 <- pm_targets |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months_pm)
pm_test0  <- pm_targets |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months_pm)

range(pm_train0$month_date); range(pm_test0$month_date)
```
```{r Progression Join Time Use}
# Collapse ptm_tc to player-month by move_rows-weighted averages across tc_bucket
ptm_pm <- ptm_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(move_rows)) |>
  dplyr::filter(move_rows >= min_moves_ptm) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    move_rows_total = sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_spent_all = sum(avg_time_spent * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_time_spent_all = sum(p90_time_spent * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_clock_after_all = sum(avg_clock_after * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    low_time_rate_all = sum(low_time_rate * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_opening_all = sum(avg_time_opening * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_middlegame_all = sum(avg_time_middlegame * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_endgame_all = sum(avg_time_endgame * move_rows, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(move_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join to player-month
pm_with_time <- pm_targets |>
  dplyr::left_join(ptm_pm, by = c("player","month"))
```

```{r Progression Join Repertoire}
# Collapse pom_tc to player-month opening shares (across tc_bucket)
pom_pm <- pom_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(opening), !is.na(games)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month, opening) |>
  dplyr::summarise(games_opening = sum(games), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month) |>
  dplyr::mutate(games_total_opening = sum(games_opening)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Concentration: share in most-played opening (top_opening_share)
top_share <- pom_pm |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    top_opening_share = max(games_opening / games_total_opening, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Churn proxy (simple): did the most-played opening change vs previous month?
top_opening <- pom_pm |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = games_opening, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, top_opening_name = opening)

opening_switch <- top_opening |>
  dplyr::mutate(month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(player, month_date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player) |>
  dplyr::mutate(prev_top_opening = dplyr::lag(top_opening_name),
                switched_opening = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(prev_top_opening) & top_opening_name != prev_top_opening, 1L, 0L)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, switched_opening)

pm_feat <- pm_with_time |>
  dplyr::left_join(top_share, by = c("player","month")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(opening_switch, by = c("player","month"))
```

```{r Progression Model Datasets}
# 1-month improvement target
dat_1m <- pm_feat |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(d_rating_1m)) 

# 3-month improvement target (harder; fewer rows)
dat_3m <- pm_feat |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(d_rating_3m))

# Stability target: absolute change
dat_abs <- pm_feat |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(abs_d_rating_1m))

# Train/test split by month (forward-in-time)
split_train_test <- function(df) {
  list(
    train = df |> dplyr::filter(month %in% train_months_pm),
    test  = df |> dplyr::filter(month %in% test_months_pm)
  )
}

spl_1m  <- split_train_test(dat_1m)
spl_3m  <- split_train_test(dat_3m)
spl_abs <- split_train_test(dat_abs)

# sanity sizes
c(
  n_train_1m = nrow(spl_1m$train), n_test_1m = nrow(spl_1m$test),
  n_train_3m = nrow(spl_3m$train), n_test_3m = nrow(spl_3m$test),
  n_train_abs = nrow(spl_abs$train), n_test_abs = nrow(spl_abs$test)
)
```

```{r Progression Predictive Ridge Benchmark}
# Predictive benchmark only; not a primary inferential model

# ---- Base (low-missingness) feature set ----
# These should be essentially complete after your pm + repertoire joins.
base_feature_cols <- c(
  "avg_rating", "games", "avg_moves", "opening_diversity",
  "top_opening_share", "switched_opening"
)

# Keep only columns that actually exist (robust to edits)
base_feature_cols <- intersect(base_feature_cols, names(spl_1m$train))

prep_xy <- function(df, ycol, xcols) {
  df2 <- df |> dplyr::select(all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |> tidyr::drop_na()
  y <- df2[[ycol]]
  X <- model.matrix(reformulate(xcols), data = df2)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  list(X = X, y = y)
}

fit_glmnet_ridge <- function(spl, ycol, xcols, label) {
  tr <- prep_xy(spl$train, ycol, xcols)
  te <- prep_xy(spl$test,  ycol, xcols)

  cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(tr$X, tr$y, alpha = 0.0)  # ridge
  pred <- as.numeric(predict(cv, newx = te$X, s = "lambda.1se"))

  metrics <- tibble::tibble(
    model = label,
    n_train = nrow(tr$X),
    n_test  = nrow(te$X),
    rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(te$y, pred),
    mae  = yardstick::mae_vec(te$y, pred)
  )

  # Coefficient table (lambda.1se), robust to column naming
  coef_mat <- coef(cv, s = "lambda.1se")
  coef_df <- as.matrix(coef_mat) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
    dplyr::rename(coef = dplyr::last_col()) |>
    dplyr::mutate(abs_coef = abs(coef)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_coef))

  list(metrics = metrics, coef = coef_df)
}

# Fit for all three targets
ridge_1m  <- fit_glmnet_ridge(spl_1m,  "d_rating_1m",      base_feature_cols, "glmnet_ridge_1m")
ridge_3m  <- fit_glmnet_ridge(spl_3m,  "d_rating_3m",      base_feature_cols, "glmnet_ridge_3m")
ridge_abs <- fit_glmnet_ridge(spl_abs, "abs_d_rating_1m",  base_feature_cols, "glmnet_ridge_abs1m")

bind_rows(ridge_1m$metrics, ridge_3m$metrics, ridge_abs$metrics) |>
  dplyr::arrange(rmse)

# Example coefficient table (use whichever you want later)
ridge_1m$coef |> dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)
```

```{r Progression Primary FE Models}
# Phase 2 primary inferential models for player progression
# Interpretation: within-player association between month-t covariates and future rating change

fit_fe_model <- function(spl, ycol, xcols, label) {
  fe_train <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  fe_test <- spl$test |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  fml_fe <- as.formula(paste0(
    ycol, " ~ ",
    paste(xcols, collapse = " + "),
    " | player"
  ))

  # Phase 1 change: cluster by player in the inferential fit
  m_fe <- fixest::feols(
    fml_fe,
    data = fe_train,
    vcov = ~player
  )

  pred <- predict(m_fe, newdata = fe_test)

  list(
    model = m_fe,
    metrics = tibble::tibble(
      model = label,
      n_train = nrow(fe_train),
      n_test_raw = nrow(fe_test),
      n_test_pred = sum(!is.na(pred)),
      rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(fe_test[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)]),
      mae  = yardstick::mae_vec(fe_test[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)])
    )
  )
}

fe_1m  <- fit_fe_model(spl_1m,  "d_rating_1m",     base_feature_cols, "fixest_player_FE_1m")
fe_3m  <- fit_fe_model(spl_3m,  "d_rating_3m",     base_feature_cols, "fixest_player_FE_3m")
fe_abs <- fit_fe_model(spl_abs, "abs_d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols, "fixest_player_FE_abs1m")

bind_rows(fe_1m$metrics, fe_3m$metrics, fe_abs$metrics) |>
  dplyr::arrange(rmse)
```

```{r Progression Predictive RF Benchmark}
# Predictive benchmark only; not a primary inferential model

fit_rf <- function(spl, ycol, xcols, label) {
  tr <- spl$train |> dplyr::select(all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |> tidyr::drop_na()
  te <- spl$test  |> dplyr::select(all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |> tidyr::drop_na()

  rf_mod <- ranger::ranger(
    reformulate(xcols, response = ycol),
    data = tr,
    num.trees = 500,
    importance = "impurity"
  )

  pred <- predict(rf_mod, data = te)$predictions

  list(
    metrics = tibble::tibble(
      model = label,
      n_train = nrow(tr),
      n_test  = nrow(te),
      rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(te[[ycol]], pred),
      mae  = yardstick::mae_vec(te[[ycol]], pred)
    ),
    importance = sort(rf_mod$variable.importance, decreasing = TRUE)
  )
}

rf_1m  <- fit_rf(spl_1m,  "d_rating_1m",     base_feature_cols, "ranger_rf_1m")
rf_3m  <- fit_rf(spl_3m,  "d_rating_3m",     base_feature_cols, "ranger_rf_3m")
rf_abs <- fit_rf(spl_abs, "abs_d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols, "ranger_rf_abs1m")

bind_rows(rf_1m$metrics, rf_3m$metrics, rf_abs$metrics) |>
  dplyr::arrange(rmse)

# Example variable importance (pick one target)
head(rf_1m$importance, 20)
```

##### Diagnostics

```{r Progression Ridge Predictive Diagnostics}
# Compare lambda.min vs lambda.1se performance (often a stability vs fit tradeoff)
glmnet_compare_lambda <- function(fit_obj, spl, ycol, xcols) {
  tr <- prep_xy(spl$train, ycol, xcols)
  te <- prep_xy(spl$test,  ycol, xcols)

  cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(tr$X, tr$y, alpha = 0.0)
  pred_min <- as.numeric(predict(cv, newx = te$X, s = "lambda.min"))
  pred_1se <- as.numeric(predict(cv, newx = te$X, s = "lambda.1se"))

  tibble::tibble(
    target = ycol,
    rmse_min = yardstick::rmse_vec(te$y, pred_min),
    rmse_1se = yardstick::rmse_vec(te$y, pred_1se),
    mae_min  = yardstick::mae_vec(te$y, pred_min),
    mae_1se  = yardstick::mae_vec(te$y, pred_1se)
  )
}

glmnet_compare_lambda(NULL, spl_1m, "d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols)
glmnet_compare_lambda(NULL, spl_3m, "d_rating_3m", base_feature_cols)
glmnet_compare_lambda(NULL, spl_abs,"abs_d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols)

# Residual distribution for ridge (1m)
tr <- prep_xy(spl_1m$train, "d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols)
te <- prep_xy(spl_1m$test,  "d_rating_1m", base_feature_cols)
cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(tr$X, tr$y, alpha = 0.0)
pred <- as.numeric(predict(cv, newx = te$X, s = "lambda.1se"))
res <- te$y - pred
ggplot(tibble::tibble(resid = res), aes(resid)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80) +
  labs(title = "GLMNET ridge residual distribution (1m)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Progression RF Predictive Diagnostics}
# Simple stability check: refit RF with different seeds and compare RMSE + importance rank
rf_stability <- function(seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  tr <- spl_1m$train |> dplyr::select(d_rating_1m, all_of(base_feature_cols)) |> tidyr::drop_na()
  te <- spl_1m$test  |> dplyr::select(d_rating_1m, all_of(base_feature_cols)) |> tidyr::drop_na()

  mod <- ranger::ranger(d_rating_1m ~ ., data = tr, num.trees = 400, importance = "impurity")
  pred <- predict(mod, data = te)$predictions
  imp <- sort(mod$variable.importance, decreasing = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(seed = seed,
                 rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(te$d_rating_1m, pred),
                 top1 = names(imp)[1],
                 top2 = names(imp)[2])
}

rf_stab_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(c(1,2,3,4,5), rf_stability)
rf_stab_tbl
```

```{r Progression Phase3 FE Helpers}
# Phase 3 helper: FE fit with arbitrary RHS and FE structure

fit_fe_spec <- function(spl, ycol, xcols, fe_rhs = "player", label = NULL) {
  tr <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  te <- spl$test |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, all_of(c(ycol, xcols))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(ycol, " ~ ", paste(xcols, collapse = " + "), " | ", fe_rhs)
  )

  mod <- fixest::feols(
    fml,
    data = tr,
    vcov = ~player
  )

  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te)

  list(
    model = mod,
    train = tr,
    test = te,
    metrics = tibble::tibble(
      model = label %||% paste0(ycol, "_", fe_rhs),
      n_train = nrow(tr),
      n_test_raw = nrow(te),
      n_test_pred = sum(!is.na(pred)),
      rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(te[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)]),
      mae  = yardstick::mae_vec(te[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)])
    )
  )
}

prog_base_features <- base_feature_cols

fe_1m_base_p3 <- fit_fe_spec(
  spl = spl_1m,
  ycol = "d_rating_1m",
  xcols = prog_base_features,
  fe_rhs = "player",
  label = "fe_1m_base"
)
```
