```{r Progression Phase3 Rating Robustness}
# Phase 3: linear avg_rating vs spline avg_rating in the primary 1m FE model

fit_fe_rating_spec <- function(spl, ycol, use_spline = FALSE, fe_rhs = "player", label = NULL) {
  tr <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(
      player, month, month_date, dplyr::all_of(c(
        ycol, setdiff(prog_base_features, "avg_rating"), "avg_rating"
      ))
    ) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  te <- spl$test |>
    dplyr::select(
      player, month, month_date, dplyr::all_of(c(
        ycol, setdiff(prog_base_features, "avg_rating"), "avg_rating"
      ))
    ) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  other_rhs <- setdiff(prog_base_features, "avg_rating")

  rating_term <- if (use_spline) {
    "splines::ns(avg_rating, df = 4)"
  } else {
    "avg_rating"
  }

  rhs <- paste(c(rating_term, other_rhs), collapse = " + ")

  fml <- as.formula(paste0(ycol, " ~ ", rhs, " | ", fe_rhs))

  mod <- fixest::feols(
    fml,
    data = tr,
    vcov = ~player
  )

  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te)

  list(
    model = mod,
    train = tr,
    test = te,
    metrics = tibble::tibble(
      model = label,
      n_train = nrow(tr),
      n_test_raw = nrow(te),
      n_test_pred = sum(!is.na(pred)),
      rmse = yardstick::rmse_vec(te[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)]),
      mae  = yardstick::mae_vec(te[[ycol]][!is.na(pred)], pred[!is.na(pred)])
    )
  )
}

fe_1m_linear_rating_p3 <- fit_fe_rating_spec(
  spl = spl_1m,
  ycol = "d_rating_1m",
  use_spline = FALSE,
  fe_rhs = "player",
  label = "fe_1m_linear_rating"
)

fe_1m_spline_rating_p3 <- fit_fe_rating_spec(
  spl = spl_1m,
  ycol = "d_rating_1m",
  use_spline = TRUE,
  fe_rhs = "player",
  label = "fe_1m_spline_rating"
)

bind_rows(
```

```{r Progression FE Paper Tables}
# ----------------------------
# 1) Coefficient table
# ----------------------------
extract_fe_coef_table <- function(mod, target_name, terms_keep) {
  broom::tidy(mod, conf.int = TRUE, vcov = ~player + month) |>
    dplyr::filter(term %in% terms_keep) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      target = target_name,
      label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[term]), term)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      target, term, label,
      estimate,
      std.error,
      conf.low,
      conf.high,
      p.value
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(target, match(term, terms_keep))
}

fe_coef_table <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ extract_fe_coef_table(.x$model_obj, .x$target, retained_predictors)
)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Predictor labels actually used
# ----------------------------
fe_predictor_labels <- tibble::tibble(term = retained_predictors) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[term]), term),
    retained_in_final_fe = TRUE
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3) Distribution summaries
#    Use FE estimation sample for each target
# ----------------------------
make_distribution_summary <- function(spl, ycol, terms_keep, target_name) {
  dat <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  purrr::map_dfr(terms_keep, function(v) {
    x <- dat[[v]]

    if (all(x %in% c(0, 1), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      tibble::tibble(
        target = target_name,
        term = v,
        label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[v]), v),
        predictor_class = "binary",
        mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        p25 = NA_real_,
        p50 = NA_real_,
        p75 = NA_real_,
        prop_1 = mean(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    } else {
      tibble::tibble(
        target = target_name,
        term = v,
        label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[v]), v),
        predictor_class = "continuous",
        mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        p25 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
        p50 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
        p75 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
        prop_1 = NA_real_
      )
    }
  })
}

fe_predictor_distribution <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_distribution_summary(.x$spl, .x$ycol, retained_predictors, .x$target)
)

# ----------------------------
# 4) Reference values for non-focal covariates
#    For contrasts, use estimation-sample means for continuous vars,
#    and 0 as reference for binary switched_opening
# ----------------------------
make_reference_values <- function(spl, ycol, terms_keep, target_name) {
  dat <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  purrr::map_dfr(terms_keep, function(v) {
    x <- dat[[v]]
    tibble::tibble(
      target = target_name,
      term = v,
      label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[v]), v),
      reference_value = if (all(x %in% c(0,1), na.rm = TRUE)) 0 else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      reference_rule = if (all(x %in% c(0,1), na.rm = TRUE)) {
        "fixed binary reference: 0"
      } else {
        "mean of estimation sample"
      }
    )
  })
}

fe_reference_values <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_reference_values(.x$spl, .x$ycol, retained_predictors, .x$target)
)

# ----------------------------
# 5) Predicted contrasts from FE models
#    Since contrast changes only one focal predictor at a time,
#    FE intercept/player FE cancel; contrast = beta * delta
#    SE(delta contrast) = |delta| * SE(beta), CI from vcov
# ----------------------------
make_contrast_table <- function(mod, spl, ycol, target_name, terms_keep) {
  dat <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  coef_tbl <- broom::tidy(mod, vcov = ~player + month) |>
    dplyr::filter(term %in% terms_keep)

  vc <- stats::vcov(mod, vcov = ~player + month)

  purrr::map_dfr(terms_keep, function(v) {
    beta <- coef_tbl$estimate[coef_tbl$term == v]
    idx <- which(names(stats::coef(mod)) == v)
    var_beta <- vc[idx, idx]
    se_beta <- sqrt(var_beta)

    x <- dat[[v]]
    is_binary <- all(x %in% c(0,1), na.rm = TRUE)

    if (is_binary) {
      low_val <- 0
      high_val <- 1
      contrast_desc <- "0 vs 1"
      ref_note <- "all non-focal continuous covariates set to estimation-sample means; binary covariates set to 0"
    } else {
      low_val <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
      high_val <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
      contrast_desc <- "25th vs 75th percentile"
      ref_note <- "all non-focal continuous covariates set to estimation-sample means; binary covariates set to 0"
    }

    delta_x <- high_val - low_val
    pred_diff <- beta * delta_x
    se_diff <- abs(delta_x) * se_beta
    ci_low <- pred_diff - 1.96 * se_diff
    ci_high <- pred_diff + 1.96 * se_diff

    tibble::tibble(
      target = target_name,
      term = v,
      label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[v]), v),
      comparison_rule = contrast_desc,
      comparison_low = low_val,
      comparison_high = high_val,
      predicted_difference = pred_diff,
      std.error = se_diff,
      conf.low = ci_low,
      conf.high = ci_high,
      reference_values_note = ref_note
    )
  })
}

fe_contrast_table <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_contrast_table(.x$model_obj, .x$spl, .x$ycol, .x$target, retained_predictors)
)

# ----------------------------
# 6) FE prediction support / sample note
# ----------------------------
make_support_note <- function(mod, spl, ycol, target_name, metrics_obj, terms_keep) {
  tr <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  te <- spl$test |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  pred <- predict(mod, newdata = te)

  tibble::tibble(
    target = target_name,
    estimation_sample_n = nrow(tr),
    estimation_players = dplyr::n_distinct(tr$player),
    test_sample_complete_cases = nrow(te),
    supported_test_predictions = sum(!is.na(pred)),
    share_supported_test_predictions = mean(!is.na(pred)),
    coefficient_interpretation_note = "Coefficient interpretation uses the full FE estimation sample after complete-case filtering for the retained predictors.",
    prediction_support_note = "Predicted contrasts are coefficient-based within-player contrasts and are not restricted to supported out-of-sample FE predictions; test-set prediction coverage is reported separately for transparency.",
    interpretability_note = "Out-of-sample FE predictions may be unavailable for player-month observations without supported fixed effects in prediction."
  )
}

fe_prediction_support <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_support_note(.x$model_obj, .x$spl, .x$ycol, .x$target, .x$metrics_obj, retained_predictors)
)

# ----------------------------
# 7) Compact model summary block
# ----------------------------
make_model_summary <- function(mod, spl, ycol, target_name) {
  tr <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, all_of(c(ycol, retained_predictors))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  tibble::tibble(
    target = target_name,
    n_observations = nobs(mod),
    n_players = dplyr::n_distinct(tr$player),
    within_r2 = as.numeric(fixest::fitstat(mod, "wr2"))
  )
}

fe_model_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_model_summary(.x$model_obj, .x$spl, .x$ycol, .x$target)
)

# ----------------------------
# 8) Optional standardized-effect block
#    Effect of 1 SD increase in each continuous predictor
#    and 0->1 change for binary
# ----------------------------
make_standardized_effects <- function(mod, spl, ycol, target_name, terms_keep) {
  dat <- spl$train |>
    dplyr::select(player, all_of(c(ycol, terms_keep))) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  coef_tbl <- broom::tidy(mod, vcov = ~player + month) |>
    dplyr::filter(term %in% terms_keep)

  vc <- stats::vcov(mod, vcov = ~player + month)

  purrr::map_dfr(terms_keep, function(v) {
    beta <- coef_tbl$estimate[coef_tbl$term == v]
    idx <- which(names(stats::coef(mod)) == v)
    se_beta <- sqrt(vc[idx, idx])

    x <- dat[[v]]
    is_binary <- all(x %in% c(0,1), na.rm = TRUE)
    scale_amount <- if (is_binary) 1 else sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

    eff <- beta * scale_amount
    se_eff <- abs(scale_amount) * se_beta

    tibble::tibble(
      target = target_name,
      term = v,
      label = dplyr::coalesce(unname(predictor_labels[v]), v),
      scaling = if (is_binary) "0 to 1 change" else "1 SD increase",
      standardized_effect = eff,
      std.error = se_eff,
      conf.low = eff - 1.96 * se_eff,
      conf.high = eff + 1.96 * se_eff
    )
  })
}

fe_standardized_effects <- purrr::map_dfr(
  model_map,
  ~ make_standardized_effects(.x$model_obj, .x$spl, .x$ycol, .x$target, retained_predictors)
)
```

```{r Progression FE Coefficient Plot}
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_few() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_player_coef

saveRDS(p_player_coef, "../files_for_submission/Paper_files/figure-rds/p_player_coef.rds")
```


#### Player Categorization

Phase 2 / Phase 3 roles for Player Categorization:

Primary descriptive clustering specification:
- k-means on standardized core + repertoire features
- `k_choose = 6`
- object: `cat_core_km`

Supporting representations / alternative clustering algorithms:
- `pca`
- `um`
- `hc`
- `gmm`

Phase 3 robustness goals:
- feature-set robustness
- algorithm robustness
- initialization stability
- month-to-month stability
- profile interpretability

```{r Categorization Prep}
# ---- Settings ----
rating_bin_width <- 200   # keep consistent with earlier sections/EDA
min_games_pm_tc  <- 10    # reliability filter for pm_tc rows
min_open_games   <- 10    # reliability filter for repertoire summaries (per player-month-tc)
min_moves_ptm    <- 40    # used ONLY for overlay profiling, not for clustering inclusion

# ---- Base: player-month-tc outcomes (high coverage) ----
pmc <- pm_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(tc_bucket),
    !is.na(avg_rating), !is.na(games)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01")),
    t = as.integer(dplyr::dense_rank(month_date)),
    rating_bin = as.integer(floor(avg_rating / rating_bin_width) * rating_bin_width)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(games >= min_games_pm_tc)

# ---- Repertoire features from player-opening-month-tc (pom_tc) ----
# We compute:
#   - open_games_total: total opening-tagged games for that player-month-tc
#   - top_opening_share_tc: concentration in most-played opening
#   - switched_opening_tc: did top opening change vs previous month (within tc_bucket)
pom_clean <- pom_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(tc_bucket),
    !is.na(opening), !is.na(games)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01"))
  )

# total opening games per player-month-tc
pom_tot <- pom_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month, tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::summarise(open_games_total = sum(games, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# top opening share per player-month-tc
pom_top_share <- pom_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month, tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    top_opening_share_tc = max(games, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(games, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# top opening name (for switching)
pom_top_name <- pom_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month, tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = games, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, tc_bucket, top_opening_name_tc = opening) |>
  dplyr::mutate(month_date = lubridate::ymd(paste0(month, "-01"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(player, tc_bucket, month_date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prev_top_opening_tc = dplyr::lag(top_opening_name_tc),
    switched_opening_tc = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(prev_top_opening_tc) & top_opening_name_tc != prev_top_opening_tc,
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, tc_bucket, switched_opening_tc)

rep_feat <- pom_tot |>
  dplyr::left_join(pom_top_share, by = c("player","month","tc_bucket")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pom_top_name,  by = c("player","month","tc_bucket")) |>
  dplyr::filter(open_games_total >= min_open_games)

# ---- Core categorization table (this is what clustering uses) ----
# IMPORTANT: we DO NOT require time-use features here.
# Use left_join so we keep pmc even if repertoire features are missing;
# then you can decide whether to drop NAs in specific features downstream.
cat_tbl <- pmc |>
  dplyr::left_join(rep_feat, by = c("player","month","tc_bucket"))

# ---- Optional time-use overlay table (for profiling AFTER clustering) ----
# Collapse player_time_month_tc is already at player-month-tc, but we filter for stability.
ptm_overlay <- ptm_tc |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(player), !is.na(month), !is.na(tc_bucket),
    !is.na(move_rows),
    move_rows >= min_moves_ptm
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player, month, tc_bucket, move_rows,
    avg_time_spent, median_time_spent, p90_time_spent,
    avg_clock_after, low_time_rate,
    avg_time_opening, avg_time_middlegame, avg_time_endgame
  )

cat_tbl_time_overlay <- cat_tbl |>
  dplyr::left_join(ptm_overlay, by = c("player","month","tc_bucket"))

# ---- Sanity checks (mirrors your earlier diagnostics) ----
cat_sanity <- cat_tbl |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    n_players = dplyr::n_distinct(player),
    n_months = dplyr::n_distinct(month),
    tc_levels = dplyr::n_distinct(tc_bucket),
    frac_with_rep = mean(!is.na(top_opening_share_tc)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat_sanity

# How many rows *also* have time-use available (for profiling only)?
time_cover <- cat_tbl_time_overlay |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    frac_with_time = mean(!is.na(avg_time_spent)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

time_cover
```

```{r Player Categorization Core Features}
# ---- Choose features (NO time-use) ----
# Outcome / performance / context
core_vars <- c(
  "avg_rating", "avg_rating_diff", "avg_moves",
  "win_rate", "draw_rate",
  "games", "opening_diversity"
)

# Repertoire proxies (from prep join)
rep_vars <- c(
  "top_opening_share_tc", "switched_opening_tc", "open_games_total"
)

use_vars <- intersect(c(core_vars, rep_vars), names(cat_tbl))

# Keep a modeling frame (drop only rows missing chosen vars)
cat_core <- cat_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin, dplyr::all_of(use_vars)) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

# Optional: stabilize heavy-tailed counts
cat_core <- cat_core |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    log_games = log1p(games),
    log_open_games = if ("open_games_total" %in% names(cat_core)) log1p(open_games_total) else NA_real_
  )

# Update feature list (swap in logs instead of raw counts)
feature_cols <- setdiff(use_vars, c("games", "open_games_total"))
feature_cols <- c(
  feature_cols,
  "log_games",
  if ("open_games_total" %in% use_vars) "log_open_games" else NULL
)

feature_cols <- intersect(feature_cols, names(cat_core))

# Matrix for modeling
X_raw <- cat_core |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(feature_cols))

# Standardize (z-scores)
X_scaled <- scale(as.matrix(X_raw))

dim(cat_core)
length(feature_cols)
```

```{r Player Categorization PCA}
pca <- prcomp(X_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# Variance explained
pve <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

pve_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  pc = paste0("PC", seq_along(pve)),
  pve = pve,
  cum_pve = cumsum(pve)
)

pve_tbl |> dplyr::slice(1:10)

# Loadings (which features define PCs)
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")

# Top contributors to first few PCs
top_loadings <- loadings |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature, names_to = "pc", values_to = "loading") |>
  dplyr::filter(pc %in% c("PC1","PC2","PC3")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(abs_loading = abs(loading)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(pc, dplyr::desc(abs_loading)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(pc) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_loadings
```


```{r Player Categorization PCA Scatter}
# Add PCA scores
scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = dplyr::row_number())

cat_plot <- cat_core |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::left_join(scores, by = "row_id")

ggplot(cat_plot, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +

       subtitle = "Each point is a player-month-tc observation; features standardized",
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Player Categorization UMAP}
set.seed(100)

um <- uwot::umap(
  X_scaled,
  n_neighbors = 30,
  min_dist = 0.15,
  metric = "euclidean",
  verbose = TRUE
)

um_df <- tibble::tibble(
  UMAP1 = um[,1],
  UMAP2 = um[,2]
) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(cat_core |> dplyr::select(player, month, tc_bucket, rating_bin))

# UMAP plots can look more convincing than they actually are; better for exploration than they are proof.
ggplot(um_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.12) +
  facet_wrap(~tc_bucket) +
  labs(title = "UMAP projection of player-month-tc behavior (no time-use)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Player Categorization Primary KMeans}
set.seed(100)

k_grid <- 2:10

# Fit KMeans_rcpp across a grid of k
km_fits <- map(k_grid, ~ ClusterR::KMeans_rcpp(
  X_scaled,
  clusters = .x,
  num_init = 50,
  max_iters = 100,
  initializer = "kmeans++"
))

# Elbow diagnostic
wss <- map_dbl(km_fits, ~ sum(.x$withinss))
wss_tbl <- tibble::tibble(k = k_grid, tot_withinss = wss)

ggplot(wss_tbl, aes(x = k, y = tot_withinss)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Primary clustering spec: k-means elbow curve", x = "k", y = "Total within-cluster SS") +
  theme_minimal()

# Primary descriptive clustering choice
k_choose <- 6
km <- km_fits[[which(k_grid == k_choose)]]

cat_core_km <- cat_core |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_km = factor(km$clusters))

um_km <- um_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_km = cat_core_km$cluster_km)

ggplot(um_km, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = cluster_km)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~tc_bucket) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Primary clustering spec: k-means clusters (k = ", k_choose, ")"),
    subtitle = "Primary descriptive solution used for profiling and robustness checks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r Player Categorization HClust}
# Sample if needed (hierarchical is O(n^2))
set.seed(100)
n_hc <- 5000
idx_hc <- if (nrow(X_scaled) > n_hc) sample(seq_len(nrow(X_scaled)), n_hc) else seq_len(nrow(X_scaled))

X_h <- X_scaled[idx_hc, , drop = FALSE]

# Distance + linkage
d <- dist(X_h)
hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")

plot(hc, labels = FALSE, main = "Hierarchical clustering dendrogram (sampled)")

# Cut into k clusters (use same k for comparability)
hc_k <- cutree(hc, k = k_choose)

hc_df <- um_df[idx_hc, ] |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_hc = factor(hc_k))

ggplot(hc_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = cluster_hc)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~tc_bucket) +
  labs(title = paste0("UMAP colored by hierarchical clusters (k = ", k_choose, ", sampled)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r Player Categorization GMM}
# GMM can be heavy; optionally sample
set.seed(100)
n_gmm <- 15000

# BIC plot to choose number of components
```

```{r Player Categorization Stability Jaccard}
# For stability, compare cluster assignments for the SAME player/tc across consecutive months.

# Ensure ordering
clust_assign <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::select(player, tc_bucket, month, month_date, cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::arrange(player, tc_bucket, month_date)

# Build consecutive-month pairs per player/tc
pairs <- clust_assign |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    next_month      = dplyr::lead(month),
    next_month_date = dplyr::lead(month_date),
    next_cluster    = dplyr::lead(cluster_km),
    # consecutive month check: difference in months == 1
    month_index     = lubridate::year(month_date) * 12L + lubridate::month(month_date),
    next_month_index= lubridate::year(next_month_date) * 12L + lubridate::month(next_month_date)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(next_month_date),
    (next_month_index - month_index) == 1L
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-month_index, -next_month_index)

# Month-level stability: share unchanged
stability_month <- pairs |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    frac_same_cluster = mean(cluster_km == next_cluster),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(stability_month, aes(x = month, y = frac_same_cluster, color = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Month-to-month stability of profile assignments",
     x = "Month",
     y = "Share with same profile next month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

stability_month |>
  dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, month) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r Categorization KMeans Diagnostics}
# Silhouette for chosen k (uses scaled space)
# Note: silhouette needs a distance; sample if too large.
set.seed(100)
n_sil <- 8000
idx_sil <- if (nrow(X_scaled) > n_sil) sample(seq_len(nrow(X_scaled)), n_sil) else seq_len(nrow(X_scaled))
X_s <- X_scaled[idx_sil, , drop = FALSE]
cl_s <- as.integer(cat_core_km$cluster_km[idx_sil])

d <- dist(X_s)
sil <- cluster::silhouette(cl_s, d)

summary(sil[, "sil_width"])
plot(sil, main = paste0("Silhouette plot (k = ", k_choose, ", sampled)"), border = NA)
```

```{r Categorization KMeans Init Stability}
# Refit same k multiple times and measure agreement via adjusted Rand index (ARI)
# (ARI in mclust)
set.seed(100)
n_rep <- 10
km_reps <- purrr::map(1:n_rep, ~ ClusterR::KMeans_rcpp(
  X_scaled,
  clusters = k_choose,
  num_init = 10,
  max_iters = 100,
  initializer = "kmeans++"
))

# Compare to first run
base_lab <- km_reps[[1]]$clusters
ari_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(1:n_rep, function(i) {
  lab <- km_reps[[i]]$clusters
  tibble::tibble(rep = i, ARI = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(base_lab, lab))
})

ari_tbl
ggplot(ari_tbl, aes(x = rep, y = ARI)) + geom_line(aes(group=1)) + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "K-means initialization stability (ARI)", x = "replicate", y = "ARI vs first run") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r Categorization Month-to-Month ARI}
# Stronger than "same label": compares clusterings between consecutive months using ARI on overlapping players.
# Works only if you have enough overlap.

assign <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::select(player, tc_bucket, month, month_date, cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::mutate(month_index = lubridate::year(month_date) * 12L + lubridate::month(month_date))

# Build consecutive month pairs by tc_bucket
ari_month <- assign |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    assign |> dplyr::transmute(player, tc_bucket, month_index = month_index - 1L, cluster_prev = cluster_km),
    by = c("player","tc_bucket","month_index")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, month_index) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_overlap = dplyr::n(),
    ari = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(as.integer(cluster_prev), as.integer(cluster_km)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ari_month |> head(12)

ggplot(ari_month, aes(x = month_index, y = ari, color = tc_bucket, group = tc_bucket)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Month-to-month clustering stability (ARI on overlapping players)",
       x = "Month index", y = "ARI") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


##### Summary

```{r Categorization Phase3 Helpers}
# ---- Phase 3 helpers for descriptive robustness ----

make_cat_design <- function(data, vars_core, vars_rep = NULL) {
  use_vars_local <- intersect(c(vars_core, vars_rep), names(data))

  out <- data |>
    dplyr::select(player, month, month_date, t, tc_bucket, rating_bin, dplyr::all_of(use_vars_local)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  out <- out |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      log_games = if ("games" %in% names(out)) log1p(games) else NA_real_,
      log_open_games = if ("open_games_total" %in% names(out)) log1p(open_games_total) else NA_real_
    )

  feature_cols_local <- setdiff(use_vars_local, c("games", "open_games_total"))
  if ("games" %in% use_vars_local) feature_cols_local <- c(feature_cols_local, "log_games")
  if ("open_games_total" %in% use_vars_local) feature_cols_local <- c(feature_cols_local, "log_open_games")

  feature_cols_local <- intersect(feature_cols_local, names(out))

  X_raw_local <- out |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(feature_cols_local))

  X_scaled_local <- scale(as.matrix(X_raw_local))

  list(
    data = out,
    feature_cols = feature_cols_local,
    X_scaled = X_scaled_local
  )
}

fit_kmeans_spec <- function(X_scaled, k, seed = 100) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ClusterR::KMeans_rcpp(
    X_scaled,
    clusters = k,
    num_init = 50,
    max_iters = 100,
    initializer = "kmeans++"
  )
}

cluster_profile_tbl <- function(data, cluster_var, feature_cols) {
  data |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[cluster_var]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      share = n / nrow(data),
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(feature_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
}
```

```{r Categorization Phase3 Feature-Set Robustness}
# Phase 3: does the broad player-type structure survive feature-set changes?

core_only_vars <- core_vars
core_rep_vars  <- c(core_vars, rep_vars)

spec_core_only <- make_cat_design(cat_tbl, vars_core = core_only_vars)
spec_core_rep  <- make_cat_design(cat_tbl, vars_core = core_vars, vars_rep = rep_vars)

km_core_only <- fit_kmeans_spec(spec_core_only$X_scaled, k = k_choose, seed = 100)
km_core_rep  <- fit_kmeans_spec(spec_core_rep$X_scaled,  k = k_choose, seed = 100)

cat_core_only_km <- spec_core_only$data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_km = factor(km_core_only$clusters))

cat_core_rep_km <- spec_core_rep$data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_km = factor(km_core_rep$clusters))

feature_robust_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  feature_set = c("core_only", "core_plus_repertoire"),
  n_obs = c(nrow(spec_core_only$data), nrow(spec_core_rep$data)),
  n_features = c(length(spec_core_only$feature_cols), length(spec_core_rep$feature_cols)),
  min_cluster_share = c(
    min(prop.table(table(cat_core_only_km$cluster_km))),
    min(prop.table(table(cat_core_rep_km$cluster_km)))
  )
)

feature_robust_tbl

prof_core_only <- cluster_profile_tbl(cat_core_only_km, "cluster_km", spec_core_only$feature_cols) |>
  dplyr::mutate(feature_set = "core_only", .before = 1)

prof_core_rep <- cluster_profile_tbl(cat_core_rep_km, "cluster_km", spec_core_rep$feature_cols) |>
  dplyr::mutate(feature_set = "core_plus_repertoire", .before = 1)

prof_core_only
prof_core_rep
```

```{r Categorization Phase3 Algorithm Robustness}
# Phase 3: do alternative algorithms recover similar broad structure?

# k-means assignments on full primary data
km_assign <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::select(row_id, cluster_km)

# hierarchical assignments only on sampled rows
hc_assign <- tibble::tibble(
  row_id = idx_hc,
  cluster_hc = factor(hc_k)
)

# GMM assignments only on sampled rows
gmm_assign <- tibble::tibble(
  row_id = idx_gmm,
  cluster_gmm = factor(gmm$classification)
)

alg_agree_hc <- km_assign |>
  dplyr::inner_join(hc_assign, by = "row_id") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_overlap = dplyr::n(),
    ari = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(as.integer(cluster_km), as.integer(cluster_hc))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = "kmeans_vs_hclust", .before = 1)

alg_agree_gmm <- km_assign |>
  dplyr::inner_join(gmm_assign, by = "row_id") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_overlap = dplyr::n(),
    ari = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(as.integer(cluster_km), as.integer(cluster_gmm))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = "kmeans_vs_gmm", .before = 1)

alg_agreement_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(alg_agree_hc, alg_agree_gmm)
alg_agreement_tbl
```

```{r Categorization Phase3 Stability Summary}
# Consolidate the main descriptive stability checks for the primary clustering solution

sil_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("mean_silhouette", "median_silhouette"),
  value = c(
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(sil[, "sil_width"], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

init_stability_summary <- ari_tbl |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_init_ari = mean(ARI, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_init_ari = min(ARI, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_init_ari = max(ARI, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

month_stability_summary <- ari_month |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_month_ari = mean(ari, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_month_ari = median(ari, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_month_ari = min(ari, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cluster_size_summary <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::count(cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_clusters = dplyr::n(),
    min_cluster_share = min(share),
    max_cluster_share = max(share)
  )

cat_phase3_stability <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  init_stability_summary,
  month_stability_summary,
  cluster_size_summary
)

sil_summary
cat_phase3_stability
```

```{r Categorization Paper Output Extraction}
# -------------------------------------------------
# 1) Standardized cluster centroids for retained features
#    These are centroids in the same z-score space used by k-means.
# -------------------------------------------------
X_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(X_scaled) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  setNames(feature_cols)

cluster_centroids_std <- bind_cols(
  cat_core_km |> dplyr::select(cluster_km),
  X_scaled_df
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(feature_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_km)

# long version if easier for tables/plots
cluster_centroids_std_long <- cluster_centroids_std |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(feature_cols),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "standardized_centroid"
  )

# -------------------------------------------------
# 2) Cluster membership counts by time control
# -------------------------------------------------
cluster_counts_time_control <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::count(tc_bucket, cluster_km, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share_within_tc = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, cluster_km)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3) Cluster membership counts by broad rating bin
# -------------------------------------------------
cluster_counts_rating_bin <- cat_core_km |>
  dplyr::count(rating_bin, cluster_km, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::group_by(rating_bin) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share_within_rating_bin = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(rating_bin, cluster_km)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 4) Month-to-month same-cluster retention rate by cluster
#    Uses already-constructed consecutive-month pairs.
# -------------------------------------------------
cluster_retention_by_cluster <- pairs |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    same_cluster_rate = mean(cluster_km == next_cluster, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_km)

# optional more detailed version by time control too
cluster_retention_by_cluster_tc <- pairs |>
  dplyr::group_by(tc_bucket, cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    same_cluster_rate = mean(cluster_km == next_cluster, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tc_bucket, cluster_km)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 5) Optional: most common transition destination by cluster
#    Excludes staying in same cluster, then finds most common destination.
# -------------------------------------------------
cluster_transition_counts <- pairs |>
  dplyr::count(cluster_km, next_cluster, name = "n_transitions") |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_from_cluster = sum(n_transitions),
    transition_share = n_transitions / total_from_cluster
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_km, dplyr::desc(n_transitions))

cluster_top_transition <- pairs |>
  dplyr::filter(cluster_km != next_cluster) |>
  dplyr::count(cluster_km, next_cluster, name = "n_transitions") |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_km) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_switches_from_cluster = sum(n_transitions),
    switch_share = n_transitions / total_switches_from_cluster
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = n_transitions, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_km)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 6) Compact paper-ready summary block
# -------------------------------------------------
categorization_output_summary <- list(
  standardized_centroids = cluster_centroids_std,
  cluster_counts_time_control = cluster_counts_time_control,
  cluster_counts_rating_bin = cluster_counts_rating_bin,
  cluster_retention_by_cluster = cluster_retention_by_cluster,
  cluster_top_transition = cluster_top_transition
)

cluster_centroids_std
cluster_counts_time_control
cluster_counts_rating_bin
cluster_retention_by_cluster
cluster_top_transition
```
